raw.title: (Senior) Privacy Manager - Governance & Legal (all genders)
raw.description:
Support us in designing the insurance experience of the future. As our (Senior) Privacy Manager (all genders), you will further shape and build getolo's privacy organisation enabling us to further scale and expand our European business. You will take ownership of developing our privacy framework, from governance structure, processes and controls to tools and documentation, and bring it to life across the company. You will report to our Head of Governance & Legal, who will be your sparring partner and support you in implementing the relevant structures.

This is a full-time hybrid role, with 1–2 days per week in our Berlin office.

Requirements

Your Mission

Strengthening our privacy organisation

  • Taking getolo's privacy organization to the next level: furthering governance model, roles and responsibilities, policies, processes and controls
  • Define clear accountabilities between business teams, privacy and control functions (3 lines of defense), and establish the corresponding reporting and escalation lines
  • Reinforce a sustainable records of processing and data inventory that will keep pace with our products and data landscape going forward
  • Furthering privacy monitoring and controls, including KPIs and regular management reporting
  • Strengthening privacy awareness across the company through training and practical guidance

 

Privacy by design & technology

  • Embed privacy by design and by default into our product and software development lifecycle
  • Work with data and engineering teams on data architecture, retention and deletion concepts
  • Drive the implementation and automation of processes and privacy tools, e.g. DSR workflows and data mapping solutions

 

Day-to-day privacy advisory

  • Act as the first point of contact for data protection issues across business projects, ensuring compliance with the GDPR, BDSG, TDDDG and related regulations
  • Conduct and guide data protection impact assessments and risk assessments with our DPO at Zurich, and drive the mitigation of identified risks
  • Prepare, review and negotiate data processing agreements, international transfer mechanisms and privacy clauses
  • Oversee the handling of data subject requests and personal data breaches, including notification processes
  • Ensure the compliant processing of special categories of personal data, in particular health data
  • Assess AI use cases from a privacy perspective and support our AI inventory and AI risk assessments
  • Continuous Exchange with our DPO and her Privacy Team at Zurich

Governance & legal support

  • Prepare, review, and coordinate commercial contracts within established templates / frameworks, involving Group Legal where required
  • Contribute to the maintenance and accuracy of legal templates, registers, and internal guidance materials
  • Monitor and give advice on legislative and regulatory developments in data protection and digital regulation

Project Management

  • Apply structured project management methodologies to deliver governance & legal initiatives efficiently
  • Scope, plan, and execute cross-functional projects, ensuring stakeholder alignment and measurable outcomes
  • Champion process optimisation and continuous improvement in operational workflows, drawing on best practices from modern legal operations and project delivery models

What you will need to succeed

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in data protection, ideally in-house in a regulated, fast-paced or international environment
  • Proven experience in building or substantially developing a privacy organisation, not only operating an existing one
  • The ability to translate legal requirements into processes, controls and clear responsibilities, and familiarity with common governance and control models
  • Technical affinity and an understanding of software development, data flows, cloud environments and automation
  • Ideally a legal background, such as the First and Second State Examination or a degree as Wirtschaftsjurist (LL.B./LL.M.); we also welcome candidates with a different background and a strong privacy track record
  • Fluent in German and English

Personal attributes

  • Strategic thinker with a hands-on approach
  • Excellent communicator and stakeholder manager
  • High integrity, sound judgement, and commercial acumen
  • Comfortable operating in a lean, high-performance environment

What would make you stand out

  • A privacy certification (e.g. CIPP/E, CIPM)
  • Experience in the insurance sector or with insurance law

Benefits

Why getolo?

🌴 Salary & Vacation

  • Attractive fixed salary
  • Start with 28 vacation days, with an increase every two years (capped at 30 days). Holidays on December 24th and 31st.

🧑‍💻 Mobility & Flexibility

  • Choose between a free Swapfiets bike, or a Berlin/Brandenburg ticket (“VBB - Jobticket”) or BVG “Deutschlandticket” subsidized by us
  • Work hybrid - from your home office or in our office in Berlin-Mitte
  • Work abroad in the EU for up to 60 days

🧘 Health

  • Benefit from free coaching sessions with nilo.health, our mental health tool
  • Test our products yourself! Choose between dentolo, petolo or vitolo

📚 Development

  • Learning Budget starting from 750 € per year
  • Regular (360 degree) feedback

🌍 Berlin Based, International Mindset

  • We communicate, collaborate, and celebrate in English to ensure everyone is included
  • Our diverse team spans from 33 different countries

🧬 Values

  • Our values are not buzzwords, but actions that are a part of our individual and collective DNA:
    • #fast: We simplify, move with urgency, and focus on outcomes
    • #brave: We take bold decisions, challenge the status quo, and act with conviction
    • #accountable: We deliver end-to-end, reduce dependencies, and own our decisions
    • #caring: We treat each other with respect, build trust, and create an environment where everyone can thrive


🙌 And much more…

  • Legendary summer and winter parties 
  • Regular team events
  • Many discounts on the corporate Benefits Platform
  • Two Community Days per calendar year
  • Pet friendly office

Sounds like the perfect job for you? We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you!

 

About getolo

Founded in 2015, getolo GmbH is an innovative and award-winning InsurTech company that offers comprehensive supplementary insurance plans in the areas of dental, pet health and liability, as well as health add-on coverage. Under the brands dentolo, petolo, patolo and vitolo, we serve over 265,000 customers across Germany, France and Spain, providing digital and hassle-free protection that seamlessly integrates into their daily lives.
We believe that prevention is always better than cure—which is why we focus on preventive care, customer-centric service, and financial security to protect our customers and their loved ones from unexpected costs. Thanks to the close collaboration of our team of market specialists and insurance experts, we continuously monitor industry developments to offer practical solutions for current challenges.
getolo's company culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and agility—always with a strong focus on the needs of our customers. With a team of around 300 employees, getolo is led by Daniel Gadea (CEO) and Laura Wulff (CGO). getolo is a partner of DA Direkt and part of the Zurich Group Germany.

 

getolo is an equal opportunity and diversity employer. We strive to create a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment for all our team members, regardless of ethnicity, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, limitations and talents of any kind, physical appearance, social background, marital status, age, or religion (or lack thereof).

When you apply, we focus solely on your experience and motivation. You decide what additional information you want to disclose (photo, marital status, religion, gender, nationality, etc.). We value and treat all applications equally.

Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Das erwartet dich Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und der Montage unserer Schaltschränke. Bei der Verdrahtung und dem Anschluss elektrischer Komponenten arbeitest Du eng mit unserem Team zusammen. Gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen unterstützt Du bei Prüfungen, Funktionstests und Inbetriebnahmen. Auch die Vorbereitung von Werkzeugen und Materialien sowie die Pflege technischer Dokumentationen gehören zu Deinem Aufgabenbereich. Das bringst du mit Du bist in einem Studium der Elektrotechnik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Studiengang eingeschrieben. Du interessierst Dich für Schaltschrankbau, Elektroinstallation und praktische Elektrotechnik. Erste elektrotechnische Kenntnisse oder praktische Erfahrungen sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Handwerkliches Geschick und technisches Verständnis bringst Du mit. Eine sorgfältige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise zeichnet Dich aus. Du verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau. Was wir bieten Du sammelst praktische Erfahrungen im Schaltschrankbau, in der Elektroinstallation und Automatisierungstechnik. Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung und feste Ansprechpartner erleichtern Dir den Einstieg. Dich erwartet ein moderner Arbeitsplatz mit professioneller technischer Ausstattung und Werkzeug. Du arbeitest an realen Projekten im Bereich der Automatisierungs- und Energietechnik mit. Ein kollegiales Team und kurze Entscheidungswege sorgen für eine angenehme Zusammenarbeit. Ehrlich gesagt: Wir suchen jemanden, der strukturiert arbeitet und Qualität schätzt. Wenn Du ein Interesse an der Automatisierungstechnik mitbringst und Lust hast, Deine theoretischen Kenntnisse in die Praxis umzusetzen, bist Du bei uns genau richtig. Nächster Schritt: Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf – ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Wir melden uns innerhalb von 3 Werktagen bei dir. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene. Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo, ein Lernbegleiter ohne Bildschirm für Kinder ab vier. Onoo fragt zurück, lässt raten und denkt mit. Er hat keine Kamera und kein Display, zeigt keine Werbung und verkauft keine Daten. Warum YLAB Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard. Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt. Du arbeitest an echten offenen Fragen, zum Beispiel wie KI Kinderstimmen versteht und Fünfjährigen die Welt erklärt. Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch. Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden. Was wir bieten Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht. Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst. Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop – du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt. Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln. Über die Rolle Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo: ein kleiner, bildschirmfreier KI-Freund, der Kindern zwischen 4 und 9 ihre Warum-Fragen beantwortet. Der Prototyp funktioniert, der Launch ist 2027. Jetzt brauchen wir jemanden, der Onoo in die Köpfe und Wohnzimmer von Eltern bringt. Du bist unsere erste Marketing-Person, mit Platz am Gründertisch. Keine Agentur, kein Team unter dir, keine fertigen Prozesse. Du baust Marke, Community und Funnel von null auf – erst mit den eigenen Händen, dann mit einem Team. Was dich erwartet: ein Hardware-Produkt plus Abo, Direktvertrieb in DACH und Eltern als Zielgruppe, die das Beste für ihre Kinder wollen und Datenschutz ernst nehmen. Und ein Thema, bei dem KI und Kinder in einem Satz stehen. Da gewinnt, wer Vertrauen aufbauen kann. Wie du uns helfen kannst Du machst aus Onoo eine Marke, die Eltern sofort verstehen: Positionierung, Story, Ton – vom Video bis zum Karton. Du baust unsere UGC-Maschine: Creator finden, briefen, Hooks schreiben, jede Woche 10–20 Ad-Varianten testen, lernen, wiederholen. Du bringst 5.000 Familien auf die Warteliste, bevor es Onoo zu kaufen gibt – und hältst sie bei Laune (Newsletter, Social, „Kinderfrage des Tages“). Du machst aus unseren Beta-Familien Fans: Reviews, Videos, Testimonials, echte Geschichten. Du baust den Funnel von Warteliste bis Abo: Landingpage, Shop, E-Mail-Flows, Empfehlungsprogramm, Abo-Aktivierung, Kündigungs-Prävention. Du schaltest Paid Social (Meta, TikTok) selbst, misst sauber (Tracking, Attribution, CAC, LTV) und entscheidest nach Zahlen. Du bringst uns in die Magazine, Podcasts und Feeds, die Eltern in DACH wirklich lesen und hören. Du machst die Gründer sichtbar (LinkedIn, Instagram) – vor dem Launch unser günstigster Kanal. Du sorgst dafür, dass unser Marketing hält, was das Produkt verspricht: keine Kinder als Werbefiguren, Datenschutz vorgelebt, Werbung sauber gekennzeichnet, kein Fake-UGC. Du hast ein Krisen-Playbook in der Schublade, falls Onoo einem Kind mal etwas Falsches sagt. Du baust ab dem Launch das Team und holst Freelancer und Agenturen dazu, wo es sich lohnt. Melde dich, wenn: Du 5+ Jahre Consumer-Marketing gemacht hast, am liebsten D2C mit Abo oder Hardware. Du schon mal eine Marke von null aufgebaut hast oder beim Aufbau ganz vorne dabei warst. Du UGC nicht nur kennst, sondern eine Creative-Testing-Maschine gebaut hast und uns sagen kannst, welche Hook-Rate dein bestes Creative hatte und warum. Du Lifecycle-Marketing kannst: Klaviyo oder Ähnliches, Flows, Segmente, Churn. Du Zahlen magst: CAC, LTV, Cohorts, Payback und mit unserem Finance-Mitgründer eine Sprache sprichst. Du selbst Ads schaltest, Texte schreibst, Videos schneidest, Decks baust und nicht nur delegierst. Du den DACH-Markt kennst und verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse mitbringst. Du KI-Tools für Content täglich nutzt und weißt, wo ihre Grenze ist. Du Kinder, Eltern und Bildung spannend findest. Nicht nur als Zielgruppe. Du Verantwortung willst, bevor alles fertig ist. Eher nicht, wenn: du zuletzt vor allem Budgets und Agenturen gesteuert hast und nicht mehr selbst Hand anlegen willst. Oder wenn du nur Performance kannst, aber keine Marke. Oder nur Marke, aber keine Zahlen. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Solutions Engineer (CS)
description: For over four decades, Cirrus Logic has been propelled by the top engineers in mixed-signal processing. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career! We are looking for a hands-on Solutions Engineer to help customers and internal teams explore what Cirrus Logic’s technologies can do in Automotive and Industrial applications. You will turn product capabilities and emerging customer needs into working solutions, proofs of concept, and compelling technical demonstrations. This role, based in our Edinburgh office, combines electronic design, software, system integration, and practical problem-solving. You will develop and deliver working solutions that demonstrate the benefits of Cirrus Logic technologies, taking ownership of technical work from concept and prototyping through system integration, evaluation, and demonstration. You will collaborate with design, applications, systems, marketing, customers, and external partners Key Responsibilities: Develop system-level solutions and demonstrations using Cirrus Logic products across Automotive and Industrial applications. Translate customer needs, use cases, and product capabilities into practical technical concepts and proofs of concept. Design, prototype, bring up, and debug electronic hardware, including PCBs, evaluation boards, and supporting circuitry. Integrate ICs, sensors, embedded software, signal paths, communications interfaces, and mechanical components into complete working systems. Develop or adapt software, scripts, and basic user interfaces to configure, control, test, and demonstrate systems. Plan and carry out evaluations, investigate system-level issues, and use measurements and hands-on assessment to guide improvements. Work with internal engineering teams and external partners to define requirements, coordinate technical work, and deliver functional prototypes and demonstrations. Prepare clear setup guides, technical documentation, and presentation materials so others can evaluate, operate, and explain the solutions. Support customer engagements, internal reviews, and industry events by demonstrating solutions and explaining their technical value. Travel internationally to support customers, tradeshows, and other business activities, expected to be approximately 4–6 weeks per year. Contribute to the mechanical design and integration of prototypes and demonstrations, working with internal specialists or external partners where needed. Required Skills and Qualifications: A degree in Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Experience developing and debugging electronic systems that combine hardware and software. PCB design experience, including schematic capture, component selection, layout review, prototype bring-up, and verification. Confidence using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analysers, power supplies, and signal generators. Practical software skills sufficient to get prototypes and demonstrations working, including writing or adapting scripts, configuring embedded platforms, integrating APIs, and debugging hardware–software interactions. The ability to use AI-assisted software development tools effectively, while reviewing, testing, and troubleshooting the resulting code. Familiarity with common hardware interfaces such as SPI, I²C, UART, and audio interfaces such as I²S or TDM. A methodical approach to troubleshooting, with the ability to move from a system-level symptom to a practical solution. The ability to take ownership of deliverables, manage competing priorities, and make sound engineering decisions. Clear communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical work to people from different disciplines. A willingness to learn new technologies and work collaboratively with internal teams and external partners to develop practical solutions. Preferred Skills and Qualifications: Experience with Automotive or Industrial electronic systems, semiconductor products, or mixed-signal applications. Familiarity with one or more relevant technology areas, such as audio, haptics, sensing, clocking and synchronisation, or power management, and their integration into practical systems. Experience developing prototypes, proofs of concept, evaluation platforms, or customer-facing demonstrations. Knowledge of networking and communications technologies used in Automotive or Industrial systems, such as Ethernet, CAN, LIN, EtherCAT, or PROFINET. Familiarity with single-pair Ethernet technologies, such as 100BASE-T1, 10BASE-T1S, or 10BASE-T1L. Experience working with OEMs, system integrators, Tier 1 suppliers, or external development partners. Familiarity with relevant functional safety, qualification, or electromagnetic compatibility standards, such as ISO 26262, IEC 61508, AEC-Q100, or CISPR 25. Experience with mechanical design and integration, including basic CAD, enclosures, fixtures, mounting arrangements, and rapid prototyping techniques such as 3D printing. Experience with system architecture, product definition, feasibility studies, teardowns, or competitive analysis. This role is based in our Edinburgh, UK office. This is a hybrid position and will follow a 2+ day in-office work schedule, with in-office days based on business needs and team preference. You must be based within commutable distance of the work location listed on the job posting, or willing to relocate prior to beginning employment with Cirrus Logic. #LI-PD1 #LI-Hybrid Export control restrictions based upon applicable laws and regulations would prohibit candidates who are nationals of certain embargoed countries from working in this position without Cirrus Logic first obtaining an export license. Candidates for this role must be able to access technical data without a requirement for an export license. We are unable to sponsor or obtain export licenses for this role. At Cirrus Logic, we believe that diversity drives innovation, and we are committed to encouraging an open and collaborative culture where different approaches, ideas, and points of view are respected and valued. We aim to promote a workplace where everyone can contribute irrespective of race, colour, national origin, religion or belief, gender or gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or disability. Our mission is to understand the world's changing potential for demand flexibility and make our evidence open and useful, so the world can run on clean electricity sooner and at lower cost. We design, run and evaluate global field trials to establish rigorous real world evidence; leverage advanced data science and open source modelling; build open source data, tools, and communities; and work with policymakers, industry leaders, and grid operators to turn our evidence into real world action. About the role: As we scale our research and ambitions, we are looking for a senior strategy manager to join our London team. You will work across CNZ's leadership team to increase the reach and impact of our work, at times operating in a capacity similar to a chief of staff. What you'll do Most of your time: Develop and scale (including securing resources where necessary) CNZ's strategic assets to increase overall impact in alignment with CNZ's mission. Examples of our strategic assets include our visiting researchers programme and our Faraday AI model. Lead research, market insights, and intelligence by curating external thinking, partnering with leading third parties to challenge our perspective, and using inventive methods to shape our research programme. Drive strategic and tactical projects from problem to delivery, and contribute to others. This is likely to include projects in support of fundraising, and may include unusual or complex field trials or modelling partnerships. Some of your time: Own and deliver strategic organisational development initiatives, including driving the adoption of AI across the business. Work closely with the CEO and executive team to drive operational excellence, championing a high-performing culture of rapid execution and seamless information flow. Demonstrable interest in the research ecosystem, in the UK and internationally. Strong interest in energy, able to learn quickly and communicate complex topics across sectors. A proven track record of working independently, driving multiple priorities at once, and seeing projects through to the finish line. An entrepreneurial instinct, able to shape ambiguity into opportunity and to separate productive risk-taking from imprudent decision making. Strong writing, analytical skills, and critical thinking; you could spot and explain an overconfident or incorrect AI contribution that others would miss. Able to work from CNZ's office near Oxford Circus, a minimum of three days per week to start. A bonus if you have: Experience of securing philanthropic, foundation or grant funding. Recent experience of using AI-based technologies to make organisations, teams and products better. Experience of open source technologies, tools, and communities. title: Director of Platform Engineering [gn] Data Intelligence Platform
description: Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale. Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term. Software engineering is being redefined. The engineers who will shape the next decade of product development are not the ones who write the most code — they are the ones who know how to think clearly, ship confidently, and use every tool available to them, including AI, to multiply their impact. The Actian Data Intelligence Platform helps teams find, understand, and use AI-ready data under clear governance. It connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, so enterprises can turn raw data into reliable decisions — the trusted foundation that AI agents increasingly depend on to work. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term. The Data Intelligence Platform has to deploy, operate, and pass audits in every one of the environments our customers run — public cloud, private cloud, and on-premises. We are standing up a dedicated platform team to make that possible, and we are hiring the leader who will build it. This is a hands-on director role. You will stand up and lead a newly formed platform team, hire and grow it, and build alongside it from day one: you will design the platform services, write infrastructure code, and set the engineering standards the rest of engineering relies on. We are an AI-first engineering organization, and in this role AI is how the work gets done. AI agents run operational tasks, AI accelerates the team's own engineering, and AI replaces tools we pay for today but no longer need. You will also build the infrastructure that runs the AI and ML workloads inside our product. What You Will Own: Platform services for the Data Intelligence Platform, including the infrastructure behind the data catalog, the knowledge graph, and the APIs that power customer integrations. Cloud-agnostic deployment of the Platform across AWS, a second public cloud (Azure or Google Cloud), and customer on-premises and private-cloud environments — including packaging, installation, upgrades, and supportability. The internal developer platform and CI/CD, including GitOps delivery, so engineering teams ship safely and quickly. Security operations and compliance evidence for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR — including EU data residency — in partnership with the security team. Cloud cost management and FinOps, with clear cost visibility and accountability across every environment. Infrastructure for the AI and ML workloads used by the Platform. Observability, reliability, and incident response for the services the team runs, including the team's on-call rotation. Building and growing the team — hiring platform engineers, setting the operating model, and establishing the standards and rituals the team works by. What You Will Deliver in Your First 12 Months: High-functioning platform team: an operating model in place, and clear ownership boundaries with the product engineering teams you serve. Portable, cloud-agnostic deployments: one deployment model that runs the Platform on AWS, on at least one other cloud, and on customer infrastructure — defined as code and delivered through GitOps. AI agents running operations: agents that handle routine operational work — triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting — with measurable reductions in manual effort and a smaller tool footprint. Platform foundations for the data catalog, the knowledge graph, and integration APIs: scalable, observable infrastructure that product teams build on. Compliance automation and audit readiness: evidence for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR collected automatically from the platform rather than assembled by hand before each audit. We expect this leader to treat AI as part of the platform. That means you will: Design and run AI agents that operate infrastructure under clear guardrails — human approval for high-risk changes, and full audit trails. Review our current tooling and retire tools that AI agents or simpler automation can replace, with a cost and risk case for each change. Use AI coding and operations assistants in your own daily work, and set the standard for how the team uses them. Build the compute, data, and access patterns that let AI and ML workloads run reliably in every environment we support. What You Bring: 10+ years in platform engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE, including 3+ years managing engineers — with experience building or scaling a team, not only running an established one. AI-first mindset, making extensive use of this technology for accelerating developments. A track record of shipping on-premises or self-hosted software that customers install and run in their own environments. Deep, hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production, infrastructure as code (Terraform/Terragrunt), and GitOps delivery with Argo CD or similar tooling. Strong AWS experience, and the judgment to design for portability rather than lock-in to a single cloud. Hands-on experience operating systems under SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR controls, including data-residency requirements. Experience managing cloud costs and making cost trade-offs explicit to engineering and business leaders. Clear written communication, suited to a fully remote team across US and EU time zones. Nice to Have: Experience running infrastructure for data platforms, data catalogs, or graph databases. Production experience on Azure or Google Cloud in addition to AWS. Experience with air-gapped or restricted-network customer deployments. Experience building infrastructure for AI and ML workloads, including model serving and vector or graph data stores. Observability with OpenTelemetry or comparable tooling, from instrumentation through alerting. Privileged access management with StrongDM or a comparable tool. What We Value: We value autonomy over process, outcomes over activity, and builders over theorists. This role suits someone who thrives when handed a hard problem, a team to build, and the space to figure it out — and who uses every tool available, including AI, to multiply the team's impact. How You Will Work: You will report to the SVP of Engineering and work closely with product engineering, security, customer success, and support. The role is fully remote from the US, UK, Spain, France or Germany, with at least four hours a day of overlap with both US Eastern Time and Central European Time. raw.title: Director of Platform Engineering [gn] Data Intelligence Platform
raw.description:
Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale. Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

Software engineering is being redefined. The engineers who will shape the next decade of product development are not the ones who write the most code — they are the ones who know how to think clearly, ship confidently, and use every tool available to them, including AI, to multiply their impact.

The Actian Data Intelligence Platform helps teams find, understand, and use AI-ready data under clear governance. It connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, so enterprises can turn raw data into reliable decisions — the trusted foundation that AI agents increasingly depend on to work. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

The Data Intelligence Platform has to deploy, operate, and pass audits in every one of the environments our customers run — public cloud, private cloud, and on-premises. We are standing up a dedicated platform team to make that possible, and we are hiring the leader who will build it.

This is a hands-on director role. You will stand up and lead a newly formed platform team, hire and grow it, and build alongside it from day one: you will design the platform services, write infrastructure code, and set the engineering standards the rest of engineering relies on.

We are an AI-first engineering organization, and in this role AI is how the work gets done. AI agents run operational tasks, AI accelerates the team's own engineering, and AI replaces tools we pay for today but no longer need. You will also build the infrastructure that runs the AI and ML workloads inside our product.

 


What You Will Own:

  • Platform services for the Data Intelligence Platform, including the infrastructure behind the data catalog, the knowledge graph, and the APIs that power customer integrations.

  • Cloud-agnostic deployment of the Platform across AWS, a second public cloud (Azure or Google Cloud), and customer on-premises and private-cloud environments — including packaging, installation, upgrades, and supportability.

  • The internal developer platform and CI/CD, including GitOps delivery, so engineering teams ship safely and quickly.

  • Security operations and compliance evidence for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR — including EU data residency — in partnership with the security team.

  • Cloud cost management and FinOps, with clear cost visibility and accountability across every environment.

  • Infrastructure for the AI and ML workloads used by the Platform.

  • Observability, reliability, and incident response for the services the team runs, including the team's on-call rotation.

  • Building and growing the team — hiring platform engineers, setting the operating model, and establishing the standards and rituals the team works by.

description: Über Bonoboo Bei Bonoboo bauen wir die Plattform für Corporate Philanthropy. Mit KI-gestütztem Matchmaking verbinden wir Unternehmen gezielt mit passenden gemeinnützigen Organisationen. Das Ziel: messbare Wirkung, effizientere Spendenprozesse und datenbasiertes gesellschaftliches Engagement. Wir sind ein wachsendes, internationales Team mit Hauptsitz in Düsseldorf und wollen die Spendenbranche nachhaltig verändern. Wo wir stehen Unser Produkt ist validiert, und erste Unternehmen setzen Bonoboo bereits zahlend ein. Wir sind mitten in der Pre-Seed-Phase, mehrere Business Angels sind an Bord, und das Kapital für die nächsten Schritte ist gesichert. Jetzt geht es darum, aus einem funktionierenden Produkt ein skalierendes Unternehmen zu machen. Dafür suchen wir dich. Wer wir sind Julia, CEO & Founder: bringt Expertise in Sales und Finance mit und verantwortet Vertrieb, Finanzen und Fundraising. Max, CTO & Co-Founder: hat Erfahrung als KI-Entwickler und verantwortet Produkt und Tech. Was uns noch fehlt, ist die Person, die den Impact-Bereich von Bonoboo nicht nur mitdenkt, sondern operativ führt und nach außen trägt. Deine Aufgaben als Co-Founder & COO Du verantwortest den gesamten Impact-Bereich von Bonoboo und gestaltest den Aufbau unseres Start-ups maßgeblich mit. Strategie & Impact Du denkst mit uns die großen Fragen: Wie skaliert Corporate Philanthropy? Wo hebeln wir Wirkung am stärksten? Du bringst strategische Klarheit in ein Feld, das oft unscharf bleibt. Operative Leitung Impact Du übernimmst die operative Verantwortung für alles, was mit Impact zu tun hat, von Prozessen bis zur Reporting-Logik. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Vision gelebte Praxis wird. NGO-Partnernetzwerk & Success Management Du baust unser Netzwerk an NGO-Partner:innen auf und pflegst es. Du verstehst ihre Bedürfnisse und sorgst dafür, dass Partnerschaften auf der Plattform für beide Seiten wirklich funktionieren. Bühne & Pitches Du bist eines der Gesichter von Bonoboo: auf Startup-Bühnen, bei Pitches und im Gespräch mit Kund:innen, Partner:innen und Investor:innen. Du erzählst unsere Story mit Substanz, Überzeugung und Begeisterung. Das bringst du mit Erfahrung in Strategy, Business Development oder Operations , idealerweise mit Berührungspunkten zu CSR, HR oder dem NGO-Sektor Umsetzungsstärke: Du treibst Dinge eigenständig voran und baust Prozesse und Strukturen auf, statt nur darüber zu reden. Kommunikationstalent: Du begeisterst andere für Impact-Themen, auf der Bühne genauso überzeugend wie im 1:1 mit unseren NGO-Partner:innen. Unternehmerisches Denken: Du willst Verantwortung für das Ganze übernehmen und Bonoboo gemeinsam mit uns aufbauen und skalieren. Leidenschaft für Impact: Du glaubst daran, dass Unternehmen und NGOs gemeinsam mehr bewegen können, wenn die Partnerschaft wirklich passt. Deine ersten Monate In den ersten drei bis sechs Monaten baust du unser NGO-Partnernetzwerk systematisch aus. Du setzt die Prozesse für Matching und Impact Reporting auf und stehst bei den ersten Pitches mit auf der Bühne. Gemeinsam mit Julia und Max legst du fest, wie Bonoboo im nächsten Jahr wachsen soll. Das bieten wir Teil des Gründungsteams: Anteile, Mitsprache und Einfluss auf die Richtung des Unternehmens. Bonoboo wird auch dein Unternehmen. Flexibles Arbeiten: Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitstag selbst und arbeitest dort, wo du am produktivsten bist. Für die wichtigen Momente treffen wir uns regelmäßig in Düsseldorf. Raum zum Wachsen: Austausch mit unseren Business Angels und Zugang zu unserem Netzwerk für deine persönliche und unternehmerische Entwicklung. Ein modernes Software-Produkt mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Impact Ein Team, das schnell entscheidet und mit Leidenschaft arbeitet Die Chance, eine ganze Branche mitzugestalten und Corporate Philanthropy neu zu denken Vergütung 3.000–6.000 € brutto im Monat, plus Unternehmensanteile. Die konkrete Beteiligung legen wir gemeinsam im Kennenlernprozess fest. So lernen wir uns kennen Erstes Gespräch: lockeres Kennenlernen. Wer bist du, wer sind wir, passt das grundsätzlich? Drittes Treffen, gerne persönlich in Düsseldorf: Wir lernen uns auf persönlicher Ebene kennen und sprechen über Anteile und die Rahmenbedingungen. Klingt nach dir? Dann melde dich bei uns. Als Operations Recruiter gestalten Sie aktiv mit, wie ein Unternehmen wächst – denn ohne die richtigen Menschen an Bord bleibt jede Wachstumsstrategie nur Theorie. Sie sind die Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereichen und Talenten, verstehen die operativen Herausforderungen im Detail und finden genau die Persönlichkeiten, die diesen Bereich voranbringen. Kein Recruiting von der Stange, sondern echtes Verständnis für Prozesse, Teams und Menschen.

Wenn Sie gern eigenverantwortlich arbeiten, ein Gespür für Menschen haben und dabei sein wollen, wenn Teams entstehen, die den Unterschied machen – dann ist diese Rolle genau richtig für Sie.

Aufgaben

  • Mit klarem Fokus auf gewerbliche Mitarbeitende übernehmen Sie die Steuerung und Verantwortung für den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung.
  • In enger Kooperation mit der Agentur für Arbeit planen und leiten Sie Bewerbertage sowie Auswahlverfahren vor Ort.
  • Sie sprechen potenzielle Kandidaten proaktiv über verschiedene Kanäle an und pflegen die Bewerberdatenbank.
  • Zur effizienten Vorqualifizierung und Auswahl geeigneter Bewerber – sowohl gewerblich als auch kaufmännisch – organisieren und führen Sie strukturierte Interviews.
  • Mit internen Stakeholdern, Personaldienstleistern sowie dem Employer-Branding-Team stehen Sie in enger Zusammenarbeit.
  • Um einen reibungslosen und skalierbaren Projektaufbau sicherzustellen, analysieren Sie Recruiting-Kennzahlen und optimieren die Prozesse fortlaufend.

Qualifikation

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre (BWL), der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, der Wirtschaftspsychologie oder eine vergleichbare kaufmännische Ausbildung bringen Sie mit.
  • Sie verfügen über fundierte Erfahrung im Recruiting.
  • Idealerweise bringen Sie zudem Kenntnisse des regionalen Arbeitsmarkts in der Supply Chain mit.
  • Kommunikationsstärke und Organisationstalent zeichnen Sie ebenso aus wie eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise.
  • Sprachlich überzeugen Sie mit sehr guten Deutsch- sowie guten Englischkenntnissen in Wort und Schrift.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung! Bei Fragen steht Ihnen Frau Sandra Heinrich, unter der Rufnummer 0179 / 322 4 223 gerne zur Verfügung.

title: Consultant SAP S/4HANA Transformation
description: Für viele Unternehmen ist S/4HANA ein Pflicht-Upgrade. Bei UNITY ist es deine Mission, daraus eine echte unternehmerische Entscheidung für unsere Kunden zu machen: Wohin soll sich die Prozess- und Systemlandschaft bewegen? Was kostet welcher Weg und wer setzt ihn um? Und wie bleibt das Programm steuerbar? Du sitzt auf der Seite des Kunden. Du gestaltest End-to-End-Prozesse, Zielarchitektur und Programmsteuerung. Die technische Implementierung übernimmt unser Partnernetzwerk. Unser Anspruch als Business Integrator: Wir schützen das, was unsere Kunden vom Wettbewerb unterscheidet (wir nennen das „Prozess-DNA“) und helfen ihnen zu verstehen, was sich nicht unterscheiden sollte. Das erwartet dich Transformationspfad entwickeln: Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden und Team an Vorprojekten zur Auswahl von ERP-Systemen samt Definition von Zielbild, Leitplanken, Zielarchitektur, Deploymentvariante (RISE vs. GROW, Cloud vs. On-Premise) und Transformationspfad (Greenfield, Brownfield, Lift-&-Shift) inklusive Business Case. Zielarchitektur mitgestalten: Du arbeitest an Clean-Core-Konzepten, an SAP Business AI Platform (BAIP) – auf Basis von SAP BTP als Entkopplungsplattform und an Datenstrategien, etwa für Datasphere oder SAP Analytics Cloud. Programme transparent begleiten: Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung einer tragfähigen Roadmap und sorgst im PMO mit Tools wie SAP Signavio, LeanIX und SAP Cloud ALM für Klarheit über Fortschritt, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten. Den richtigen Partner an Bord holen: Du gestaltest Transformationsausschreibungen – im Mittelstand und Konzern ebenso wie vergaberechtskonform bei öffentlichen Auftraggebern und Kliniken. KI dort einsetzen, wo sie wirkt: Du identifizierst Use Cases for SAP Business AI und Joule, etwa in der Custom-Code-Analyse, bei der Datenqualität oder mit unseren KI-Agents in Einkauf, Supply Chain und Order-to-Cash. Branchenwissen aufbauen: Du arbeitest in Industrie und Handel, im Krankenhaus (IS-H-Ablösung, KIS-Szenarien) oder in der Energiewirtschaft (IS-U). Künstliche Intelligenz @UNITY Bei UNITY arbeitest du mit KI, die du selbst mitgestalten kannst: die eigenentwickelte UNITY X-Plattform gibt dir Zugriff auf verschiedene Claude-, ChatGPT & Gemini Modelle. Copilot und Claude-Modelle sind direkt in Teams und den Microsoft-Anwendungen verfügbar. In Copilot Studio kannst du außerdem eigene Agenten bauen, wenn du willst. UNITY Coding Communities, Hackathons, AI Labs und das AI Trainings Camp geben dir Raum, eigene Lösungen für intern und für Kunden zu bauen. Das bringst du mit Must-haves Junior Erste Praxiserfahrung entweder in einer Management- oder IT-Beratung oder auf Kundenseite in der Industrie Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse in mindestens einem Bereich, zum Beispiel Finance, Logistik, Einkauf, Produktion oder Vertrieb, und Freude daran, diese zu analysieren und zu optimieren Grundkenntnisse der SAP-Vorgehensmodelle, etwa SAP Activate, und der Migrationsszenarien Die Fähigkeit, KI wirksam und sicher anzuwenden. Prägnante Kommunikation und Präsentation auf Deutsch (C1) und Englisch (mindestens B2) Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, der Produktionstechnik oder ein vergleichbarer Abschluss mit technischem oder betriebswirtschaftlichem Schwerpunkt Idealerweise Erste Erfahrungen aus SAP-S/4HANA-Projekten Erste Berührungspunkte mit SAP BTP, Signavio oder LeanIX Branchenerfahrung in Industrie, Healthcare oder Energie (Senior Level): Entwicklung Architektur-Roadmaps rund um Clean Core und BTP. (Senior Level): Übernahme von Teilprojektleitungen oder Streamleadfunktion. Senior Level: Das bringst du zusätzlich mit Du hast bereits mindestens eine S/4HANA-Transformation über mehrere Phasen begleitet. Du bist an der Steuerung von Implementierungspartnern beteiligt gewesen und hast Scope-Entscheidungen mit dem Management deiner Kunden mitgetroffen. Du hast Erfahrung in der Sammlung und Darstellung von Use Cases und/oder Change-Requests im Kontext von SAP S/4HANA Transformations-Programmen. Juniors coachst du im Projekt, und du bringst eigene Ideen in unser SAP-Leistungsangebot ein. Ehrlich gesagt: Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn du vor allem selbst customizen oder in ABAP entwickeln willst. Die Implementierung liegt bei unseren Partnern, deine Stärke liegt im Steuern, Gestalten und Entscheiden. Sie passt auch nicht, wenn du lieber ein Modul tief betreust, als den Blick über Prozesse, Daten und Organisation hinweg zu weiten. Wenn dich dagegen die Frage reizt, wie aus einem ERP-Projekt messbarer Business-Nutzen wird, dann bist du bei uns richtig. Deine Chancen und Möglichkeiten Projekte mit Substanz: Du begleitest Transformationsprogramme von der Strategie bis zum Go-Live, in Industrie, Healthcare und Energie, und siehst, wie aus einem ERP-Projekt Business-Nutzen wird. Fachlicher Austausch auf Augenhöhe: Du arbeitest mit den Köpfen hinter unserem SAP-Angebot, darunter unsere Heads of SAP Architecture & Innovation und SAP Transformation Excellence. Partnernetzwerk statt Einzelkämpfertum: Du steuerst gemeinsam mit Implementierungspartnern, statt alles selbst zu bauen, und lernst dabei die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette einer Transformation kennen. SAP-Innovation aus erster Hand: Mit unserem zentralen KI-Team, AI Labs und Hackathons entwickelst du Business-AI-Use-Cases für den SAP-Kontext mit. Entwicklung vom Junior zum Senior: Deine SAP-Laufbahn ist bei uns kein Zufall, sondern ein Pfad bis zur Projektleitung und Architekturverantwortung. UNITY unterstützt diese Entwicklung mit konkreten Zertifizierungen, die zu deinem Entwicklungsziel passen, sowie einem breiten Portfolio an Fach- und Persönlichkeitsentwicklungsschulungen. KI, die wir selbst bauen: Zentrales KI-Team, AI Labs, Hackathons und unsere eigene UNITY X-Plattform – du entwickelst Business-AI-Use-Cases mit, statt sie nur zu präsentieren. Wohnort-Freiheit: Du arbeitest an dem deutschen UNITY-Standort, der zu dir passt, zur Auswahl stehen neun. Verwirkliche mit uns deine Big Five for Life in einer Kultur, die von Vertrauen, Authentizität und Zusammenhalt geprägt ist. Und obendrauf : Unternehmerischer Freiraum für eigene Ideen, flexible Arbeitsmodelle (u. a. Homeoffice), Sabbaticals, persönliches Coaching, Mentoring und UNITYacademy, ein individuelles Mobilitätskonzept, JobRad, Urban Sports Club und mehr. *UNITY lebt Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit. Bei uns ist jeder unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Handicap, Religion und Alter willkommen. Must-haves Junior

  • Die Fähigkeit, KI wirksam und sicher anzuwenden.

  • Prägnante Kommunikation und Präsentation auf Deutsch (C1) und Englisch (mindestens B2)

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, der Produktionstechnik oder ein vergleichbarer Abschluss mit technischem oder betriebswirtschaftlichem Schwerpunkt

Idealerweise

title: Senior Product Designer, Security
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

IMPORTANT - this role is initially offered as a 12-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of an extension depending on business needs.

We see design as a crucial element of achieving our mission, so designers are represented at all levels, including senior leadership. As our new Senior Product Designer, you will be empowered to concentrate on design solutions for people’s needs. The design organisation is well established and our impact is highly valued. That means you will be able to fully focus on your contribution to our success. 

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Product Designer to join our Security domain. The team works to keep Vinted safe and trusted without compromising the member experience. This work goes beyond preventing fraud and abuse: you’ll also shape a new, high-impact member-facing experience that broadens how people can safely access and use Vinted.

As a Senior Product Designer in Security, you’ll own complex, ambiguous product problems from discovery through delivery, turning questions around trust, access, and protection into intuitive, accessible, and easy-to-use solutions. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, data analysts, content designers, and other designers, balancing strong safeguards with clarity and ease for millions of members.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Work with cross-functional partners to be the voice of our members, define problems and goals, map flows, prototype interactions, and support the development process.
  • Own complex product work end to end, from framing the right problem and defining the experience architecture through prototyping, implementation, launch, and iteration.
  • Use AI-assisted building tools to turn ideas into working experiences, test assumptions early, and accelerate delivery, while critically assessing their output and knowing when human judgement is essential.
  • Partner up with other domain designers to work on initiatives that keep raising design quality and user-centeredness maturity. 
  • Conduct usability tests to assess and validate design ideas and collaborate with User Researchers on discovery and generative studies.
  • Give and solicit feedback from designers and cross-functional partners.
  • Be part of our Security domain and report to the Product Design Director.

About you 

  • Strong proven experience (typically 5+ years) designing complex web or native mobile products and taking them from ambiguous problem spaces through implementation, launch, and measurable outcomes.
  • Interaction design, visual design and evaluative user research skills. 
  • Good at working with complex systems
  • Excellent communication skills, including excellent written and spoken English.
  • Good understanding of the design process, designing with qualitative and quantitative insights.
  • A strong collaborator with cross-functional peers.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted prototyping or building tools to create, test, and ship working product experiences.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strategic impact, complex problem-solving, and proof of shipping, including your personal contribution, delivery trade-offs, collaboration through implementation, and what changed after launch.
  • Experience contributing code-based prototypes or pull requests within an engineering workflow is a plus.

Only applications that include a portfolio will be considered.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:
€77.100—€104.300 EUR

description:

Information about the position 

You'll join Vinted's Trust & Safety domain, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. Across several detection, moderation and sanctioning teams, we run a growing set of machine learning models, rule engines, and LLM agents. They score every new listing, account and message at Vinted's scale, and many of them act on members automatically.

We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist to shape the architecture and effectiveness of our detection systems as a whole. You'll tackle problems that individual teams cannot solve independently: how to maximize detection coverage, combine different models into coherent risk decisions, and allocate computational resources where they reduce the most harm. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with scope across Trust & Safety and Security domains. You'll set technical direction, challenge existing approaches, prototype solutions and work with teams to bring them into production.

It's an opportunity to shape how a large-scale, increasingly AI-driven safety system is built, evaluated and improved.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Design the end-to-end ML architecture for detection, risk scoring, routing and decision-making.
  • Develop cost-efficient, layered inference strategies that combine broad, low-latency screening with deeper, more expensive analysis where it adds the most value.
  • Establish approaches to continuous risk assessment across the member lifecycle, from registration and listing creation to ongoing activity.
  • Define how we measure end-to-end detection effectiveness, including precision, coverage, missed harm and computational cost. Use these measurements to identify the highest-impact improvements.
  • Turn siloed, team-level models into a coherent, calibrated detection system by addressing the technical and organisational barriers that lead to local optimisation.
  • Identify and close detection coverage gaps, ensuring that relevant signals and outcomes are available for evaluation, diagnosis and continuous improvement.
  • Set shared technical standards and architectural direction across teams, working with engineering and data science leaders to translate them into production systems.
  • Prototype critical components, test architectural assumptions empirically and build reference implementations that teams can scale.
  • Explain complex ML trade-offs to senior technical and business leaders as clear choices about harm reduction, cost, and engineering investment.

About you 

  • Have 8+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or a similar role, including significant time owning production models or model evaluation at scale.
  • Have led cross-team technical work without formal authority, and you're comfortable setting standards that other teams adopt.
  • Have deep expertise in statistical inference and experimentation: A/B testing, measuring precision and recall under imperfect or biased labels, sampling for ground truth, and causal reasoning.
  • Understand the ML lifecycle in production: evaluation, threshold setting, retraining, drift, feature stores and monitoring.
  • Have hands-on experience evaluating LLM-based systems, or a strong interest in building rigorous methods for them.
  • Are highly proficient in SQL and Python and comfortable working in a modern data stack (e.g. BigQuery, dbt).
  • Can turn messy, cross-system problems into a clear plan, and can explain trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
  • Are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  • Nice to have: experience in Trust & Safety, fraud prevention, content moderation, or risk management.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

Information about the position 

As Staff / Senior Staff Security Engineer in Vinted Pay, you will be the staff-level security engineer inside our regulated payments business - and the person who makes Vinted Pay's security posture match its growth. Vinted Pay is a rare security problem in the best sense: a fintech scaling across multiple European licences at marketplace speed, where security cannot be a compliance checklist or an isolated engineering task - it has to be built into the core financial architecture. Its attack surface spans multi-region AWS infrastructure, payment pipelines and payment pages, wallets holding members' money, the cardholder and personal data behind them, and a regulatory perimeter - PCI DSS, DORA, Bank of Lithuania and FCA rules - that rises every year.

Working at staff / senior staff level as an individual contributor embedded in the Payments Engineering leadership team, you will own the security of that whole estate. Vinted Security runs a federated model: the central team sets thresholds and provides core services (pentesting, threat intelligence, SSDLC tooling, compliance), while each business unit owns local execution. Vinted Pay already owns part of its local execution; your job is to lead and scale it - this is not a policy or audit role, it is an engineering role with a mandate: translate regulatory requirements into technical guardrails and drive practical controls alongside Vinted Pay's platform and software engineers. You will work directly with Vinted Pay's Director of Engineering and functionally with the Vinted Security senior team and your security peers in Marketplace, Vinted Go, and Platform.

This is a build role with room to grow: you start hands-on, closing the highest-impact gaps yourself and setting direction for the security work already under way, and as the function matures you will shape and functionally lead Vinted Pay's security engineering capability.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Own the Vinted Pay security roadmap end to end: assess the estate, prioritise by real attack paths, and drive risks to closure - a multi-quarter roadmap that shapes how Vinted Pay defends its infrastructure and payment assets, rather than reacting to the next audit.
  • Turn regulation into engineering: map PCI DSS, DORA, and Bank of Lithuania and FCA requirements into practical, automated security controls and engineering guardrails - compliance as a by-product of how Vinted Pay builds, not a parallel workstream.
  • Find and close the operational blind spots: run deep technical reviews of our AWS infrastructure, payment pipelines, SIEM and logging, and vulnerability management tooling (e.g. Wiz), and fix what you find - prioritised by exposure, not by finding count.
  • Own PCI DSS and data protection architecture: payment page isolation, script monitoring, data encryption, and least-privilege access across multi-region environments - and turn those controls into evidence that stands up to assessors and regulators.
  • Lead cross-functional security initiatives across Payments Platform, Payments Engineering, and Group Security, and drive them to delivery - whether execution sits with partner teams or you have to write the code yourself.
  • Act as the technical arm of Vinted Pay's security accountable: maintain the risk register, prepare mitigation-or-acceptance decisions against centrally set thresholds, and represent Vinted Pay in the group's security governance.
  • Embed secure development into Payments engineering so security lands at design time rather than after deployment, and raise the security fluency of Vinted Pay engineers so risk-based decisions happen well without you in the room - security as a delivery enabler, not a gate.

About you 

  • Strong hands-on security engineering experience on a real engineering foundation - you have built or run large production systems, and you can threat-model a payment flow, find the attack path yourself, and drive or build the fix.
  • Experience in regulated payments or fintech - you have worked under PCI DSS and a financial regulator (FCA, Bank of Lithuania, CSSF, or equivalent) and know how their requirements become controls engineers actually run.
  • A staff- or principal-level track record - you have defined, led, and delivered major, company-wide technical initiatives, and you set security direction through software design on high-scale, distributed systems rather than from the outside.
  • The range to move across the four archetypes of staff engineering - tech lead, architect, solver, right hand - picking the one the domain needs together with the Director of Engineering, not the one you prefer.
  • A way of working that engineers respect: evidence over assertions, attack paths over checklists, guardrails over gates.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and translate technical risk into business consequence for senior audiences, internal and external.
  • Comfortable in our stack - Ruby on Rails, Go, MySQL, Temporal, AWS, SIEM and CSPM tooling - or eager to learn it, with a real interest in security and privacy as a field and the appetite to keep growing as an engineer and leader.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Advantage: experience building and running systems at massive scale (2+ million requests per minute), deep knowledge of observability tooling (Kibana, Grafana, Prometheus), and a passion for introducing new practices.
  • Advantage: AWS security depth (IAM, KMS, multi-account and multi-region architecture), or hands-on CSPM (e.g. Wiz) and SIEM engineering.
  • Advantage: privacy engineering experience, or offensive security background or certifications (e.g. OSCP).

description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

 

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

 

 

What does the team work on?

Roku TV is where embedded systems, media experiences, and intelligent software come together at massive scale. The Roku TV organization builds technology used on millions of TVs globally, and the team is already applying AI to demanding TV problems in resource-constrained environments where quality, performance, and reliability matter.
As part of this team, you will help define how agentic AI systems are designed, built, and operated for Roku TV use cases. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who treats AI agent design as an engineering discipline: architecting durable systems, grounding them in the right context, integrating them with tools and services, and making them reliable in production.

 

What is the role?

We are looking for a hands-on, systems-oriented Agentic AI Engineer of roughly 2-5 years experience to design, build, and maintain intelligent agents and copilots that drive automation, accelerate workflows, and unlock new product and platform capabilities for Roku TV. You will own the full lifecycle of agent development—from prototyping and architecture through orchestration, evaluation, deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.
You will contribute directly to Roku’s AI strategy by engineering reusable components, optimizing agent workflows, and ensuring strong real-world performance in production environments.

 

How will I use AI at Roku? 

At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 

 
We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.  

 

What are the responsibilities of the role?

  • Architect, develop, and deploy AI agents and copilots for Roku TV use cases, integrating them with internal systems, tools, and services.
  • Own end-to-end agentic systems from concept to production, including model selection, prompt and context design, retrieval strategies, backend services, and conversational interfaces.
  • Design and implement single-agent and multi-agent orchestration patterns, including handoffs, delegation, and cooperative task execution.
  • Build scalable RAG and context pipelines that provide high-quality grounding for AI systems and keep them aligned with evolving data sources and business logic.
  • Implement tool-calling, function-calling, and MCP-style integrations so agents can safely take actions and interact with the systems around them.
  • Create reusable agent templates, modular components, and paved-path patterns that accelerate adoption across teams and use cases.
  • Establish strong evaluation, observability, and monitoring for conversation quality, task success rate, latency, cost, and overall system performance.
  • Build safeguards that improve production readiness and reliability, including testing pipelines, controlled rollouts, drift detection, and mechanisms that prevent error amplification in multi-step workflows.
  • Prototype quickly, run experiments, and translate successful ideas into durable, scalable software solutions.
  • Partner closely with engineering, product, QA, infrastructure, and cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful business and customer outcomes.

 

 

What experience would help someone be successful in the role at Roku? 

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
  • 2-5 years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, backend development, or adjacent domains, with strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to build production-grade systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, plus experience with C/C++ or another systems language.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-based systems, including prompt design, retrieval, tool use, memory handling, and agent orchestration patterns.
  • Experience building and maintaining RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, MCP servers or equivalent function-calling architectures, and conversational interfaces.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, REST APIs, containerization, and modern deployment environments.
  • Experience with observability, evaluation, experimentation, and feedback loops for AI systems in production.
  • Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, move quickly, and deliver incrementally in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, sound engineering judgment, and a collaborative working style.

 

Nice to have

  • Experience with multi-agent frameworks or orchestration systems such as LangChain, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.
  • Experience with video, audio, TV, or edge-device environments, especially where latency, cost, and hardware constraints matter.
  • Familiarity with ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Research experience, paper implementation experience, or a habit of applying emerging GenAI techniques pragmatically to real problems.

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

 

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

 

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to  

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

  • Ability to explore complex problem spaces objectively from multiple points of view

title: Fullstack Engineer - Mid Level - Actions Team
description:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

We're looking for a Fullstack Engineer to join our Actions team in building the core infrastructure that powers our plugin platform. You'll create the UI components, integration layers, and security mechanisms that enable our customers to extend the platform with custom integrations while maintaining safety and flexibility across our 1,500+ customer base. This is essential infrastructure work that shapes how our customers scale their integrations.

Our environment

  • Working with skilled and like-minded professionals in a team that values diversity and inclusivity
  • We aim to create a flexible and agile work environment that promotes the well-being and work-life balance of our employees
  • We believe that team events during working hours play a vital role in building an exceptionally effective team, and we encourage them
  • We are enthusiastic about technology and committed to using it to improve the world
  • We follow the “You build it, you run it” approach and take pride in it

The Team

The Actions team sits at the heart of Staffbase's AI ambitions. We're the team that gives Navigator — our AI assistant and the main entry point into Staffbase — the ability to actually do things: submit a form, complete a task inside an integration, or take an action on a user's behalf through the agent. If Navigator is the brain, we build the hands.

That means two big things. First, we enrich what the AI can see and act on, our plugins, our widgets and the wider Staffbase platform so the assistant can do real work, not just talk about it. Second, we build the extensions that connect to the tools people already use, like Workday, Personio, ServiceNow and Microsoft. We're not just shipping features, though.
