We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍London / UK Remote | 💰 Staff Backend Engineer (L60) £130,000 - £170,000 + Equity + Benefits | Technology - Engineering  

About our Engineering Teams:

We have around 650 engineers out of roughly 5,500 people in total - and we have big ambitions. There are many interesting challenges ahead, and we're happy for people to move between teams or to specialise, whatever you prefer. As an engineer here you'd be able to work directly with anyone across the company, and we run regular knowledge-sharing sessions so you’ll learn heaps about everything from how banks work to effective communication.

We contribute to open source software as much as possible. Our blog is a good place to learn even more about what we do!

What you’ll be working on: 

We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies:

  • Go to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial here)
  • Cassandra for most persistent data storage
  • Kafka for our asynchronous message queue
  • Envoy Proxy for RPC
  • Kubernetes and Docker to schedule and run our services 
  • AWS for most of our infrastructure
  • React for internal web dashboards
  • We also have two physical datacenter sites with actual cables to connect to various third parties

Your day-to-day   

This role is all about collaborating across disciplines to test hypotheses and make a difference to customers. As a product backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more! 

Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). Our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront - from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.

Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.

How we work 💻

Locations & Flexible Working: 

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. 

We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. 

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

You should apply if:

  • you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product
  • you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day
  • you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions
  • you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity
  • you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software
  • you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).
  • you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing

We're on the look out for L60 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our Engineering Progression Framework we are also hiring on L40 & L50, our interview process will determine your levelling. 

The Interview Process:

Our interview process involves three main stages: 

  1. Initial Call 
  2. Take home task or pair coding exercise 
  3. Final interview including a system design and a behavioural interview 

Our average process takes around 2-3 weeks but we will always work around your availability. 

One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see here.

💰 £130,000 - £170,000 + Equity

✈️We can help you relocate to the UK 

✅ We can sponsor visas.

📍This role can be based in our London office or remotely across the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

We have around 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.

These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.

This role is all about collaborating with your team to make a difference to your customers. Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). They are: Core Banking, Business Banking, Wealth, Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Platform, Fincrime, Security & Expansion. All of our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront- from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.

They’re all looking for additional Backend Engineers right now, we do a standard interview process across all our collectives and at the end we will find the best match for you based on your skills, experience, preferences and aligning with the business need! 

Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️

Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency 🕣✨

If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

  • you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day
  • you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions
  • you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity
  • you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software

  • you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing

  • Go to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial here)
  • Cassandra for most persistent data storage
  • Kafka for our asynchronous message queue

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels. Test, validate and deploy infrastructure changes through CI/CD (continuous integration and continuous delivery) pipelines, making sure they are robust, well documented and ready for production. title: Senior Agronomist - Digital Agronomist Products (all genders)
description: The team at Klim is building the operating system for regenerative agriculture. We help farms restore their soil - and turn that into real, measurable business value for the food companies, banks and insurers who depend on it. We’re a Berlin-based agritech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and ADM to build supply chain resilience through regenerative agriculture. Since 2020, we’ve supported +4,000 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares. Join our incredible team of 80+ dedicated people across Germany, the UK, Poland and Czechia to help build a more sustainable, resilient food system and drive real climate impact. Your mission: You are responsible for translating regenerative agricultural expertise and science in arable farming systems in temperate climates into actionable, scalable digital products for farmers on Klim's platform. You ensure that Klim’s digital products are agronomically sound, farmer-relevant, commercially viable and delivered with high quality. Your responsibilities: Own the agronomic logic behind farmer-facing recommendations and assessments - cover crop mixes, tillage transitions, rotation changes, nutrient decisions - and judge whether a given recommendation makes sense for a given soil, location and goal. Translate agronomy into buildable products. Turn agronomic principles into clear product and engineering specifications. Bring empathy to the farmer’s context into our products. What is going on around our product for the farmers, what data are accessible and reasonable to ask for, what value we can deliver back to famers. Act as a sparring partner to product, design and modelling. Challenge assumptions, find the gaps in our thinking, and say when an approach won't land with a farmer. Challenge models and outputs against field reality. You dig into the numbers, spot what doesn't add up, and explain why a result contradicts what you would expect from experience. Think like the farm owner, not just the agronomist. Tell us where farmers will hesitate, what proof they'll ask for, and what makes the change worth it to them, in money and beyond. Own and review agronomic datasets, literature, and assumptions used in digital products. Contribute to roadmap and prioritization decisions based on farmer value, willingness to pay, partner value, technical feasibility, and strategic relevance. Support farmer validation through interviews, feedback analysis, test cases, and field-reality checks. Support expansion into new regions by working out how farming systems differ and what that means for our recommendations. Your profile: You have 5+ years of experience in farm management, agronomic advisory, farm business consultancy, or a comparable role where you carried responsibility for real decisions on real farms. You have a solid academic background in agronomy, agricultural sciences, or a related discipline. A strong practical track record can stand in its place. You have strong, hands-on experience in open-field arable systems (cereals, oilseeds, root crops) in temperate Europe. You have a deep understanding of regenerative arable farming, including soil health, nutrient management, crop rotations, cover crops, tillage, and reduced-input systems. You have proven hands-on farm economics experience. You have built an investment case alongside a farmer and know which arguments actually convince, and which don't. You combine regenerative conviction with practical judgment. You believe in regenerative impact and know what farmers will realistically adopt: no evangelism, no greenwashing. You are interested in technology. You have used farm software, and follow what is happening in the space and believe in the potential but also see the issues. You can find your way around a spreadsheet or a set of performance figures and spot where the logic breaks. You have a creative spark. Given a half-formed idea, you improve it rather than only evaluate it. Languages Fluent English and fluent German. Most of our farmers are German, and you will be talking to them, reading their feedback and reviewing German farmer-facing copy. Experience of the German market is a strong advantage. Your benefits: Opportunity : Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company. Impact : Make a daily and active contribution to combating climate change, promoting consumer education, and fostering fair conditions for our climate-conscious farmers. Autonomy : Take ownership of your projects and enjoy a high degree of creative freedom. Flexible work model : At Klim, we foster a flexible, hybrid work approach and facilitate remote work (within the EU). It is advantageous for this role if you live in Berlin or can be present in our office regularly. Additional benefits for Germany-based employees : We offer a subsidy for a membership in Urban Sports Club or the Deutschlandticket, a company pension scheme, plus team lunches (if based in Berlin) and regular team events. At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for our team in ways you don’t yet realise! title: Senior Backend Engineer (Mobile Monetization) | Feeld
description: GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive. GT’s mission is to connect the world’s best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands. On behalf of Feeld , GT is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help them improve their inclusive dating application. About the Client Founded in 2014 as a dating app, Feeld gathered millions of users in one place to create a safer and more inclusive space online for everyone open to experiencing people and relationships in a new way. Their mission is to elevate the human experience of sexuality and relationships and create a world where everyone is more intimately connected to each other and themselves. The technology stack of the project: Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL/REST, TypeScript, AWS, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, SQS, EventBridge, WebSockets. About the Role We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Mobile Monetisation) to take ownership of the backend systems powering Feeld's subscription and in-app purchase experiences across iOS and Android. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with mobile monetisation platforms such as Adapty, RevenueCat, or similar solutions , as well as integrating mobile payment flows with custom backend services. This includes managing subscription lifecycles, synchronising payment data, handling receipts, and ensuring accurate entitlement management. We're looking for a highly experienced, proactive engineer with the potential to act as a technical lead , capable of independently driving complex technical initiatives, contributing to architectural decisions, and ensuring the reliability and scalability of revenue-critical systems. 📌 Full-time, long-term ⌛️ Preferred immediate start Responsibilities: Take ownership of the backend systems supporting Feeld’s monetisation, ensuring their reliability, performance, and contribution to business goals. Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and integrations for subscriptions, billing, payment processing, entitlements, pricing, and promotional features. Ensure the accuracy, stability, and reliability of monetisation flows, proactively identifying and resolving production issues that could impact revenue or user experience. Support the development and optimisation of subscription and payment flows, including improvements to system performance, scalability, and error handling. Implement and maintain feature flags, testing, and analytics instrumentation to support experimentation and continuous improvement of monetisation features. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to build and improve analytics and reporting capabilities, providing insights into revenue performance, user behaviour, and system health. Essential knowledge, skills & experience: 5+ years of commercial backend development experience , ideally building high-load, business-critical systems. Proven experience with mobile monetisation and subscription platforms , such as Adapty, RevenueCat, or comparable solutions. Hands-on experience implementing mobile in-app purchases and subscription flows for iOS and/or Android applications, beyond web-based payment integrations. Experience integrating mobile payment platforms with custom backend systems , including payment data synchronisation, receipt handling, subscription status tracking, and entitlement management. Strong understanding of mobile subscription and payment lifecycles , including renewals, cancellations, refunds, failed payments, and subscription state changes. Experience ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and consistency of revenue-critical backend systems , including troubleshooting production issues. Strong backend development experience with Node.js or TypeScript or JavaScript , ideally using NestJS and building GraphQL or REST APIs. Good understanding of event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and distributed systems . Experience writing reliable unit and integration tests . Strong technical ownership, independent problem-solving, and architectural decision-making skills, with the potential to take on technical leadership responsibilities . Strong communication skills and full professional proficiency in English. Nice to Have Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure , SQL and NoSQL databases. Our current stack includes ECS, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge, and PostgreSQL. Experience working directly with Apple App Store and Google Play billing ecosystems . Experience running monetisation experiments , including A/B testing, subscription pricing changes, and conversion optimisation. Experience managing regional pricing, multiple currencies, and country-specific monetisation strategies . Experience analysing the performance of monetisation experiments, including revenue, subscription conversion, and retention metrics. Previous experience acting as a Tech Lead or Lead Backend Engineer , mentoring engineers, and driving technical decisions. The technology stack of the project: Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL/REST, TypeScript, AWS, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, SQS, EventBridge, WebSockets.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Mobile Monetisation) to take ownership of the backend systems powering Feeld's subscription and in-app purchase experiences across iOS and Android.

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with mobile monetisation platforms such as Adapty, RevenueCat, or similar solutions, as well as integrating mobile payment flows with custom backend services. This includes managing subscription lifecycles, synchronising payment data, handling receipts, and ensuring accurate entitlement management.

We're looking for a highly experienced, proactive engineer with the potential to act as a technical lead, capable of independently driving complex technical initiatives, contributing to architectural decisions, and ensuring the reliability and scalability of revenue-critical systems.

📌 Full-time, long-term
⌛️ Preferred immediate start

Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the backend systems supporting Feeld’s monetisation, ensuring their reliability, performance, and contribution to business goals.

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and integrations for subscriptions, billing, payment processing, entitlements, pricing, and promotional features.

  • Ensure the accuracy, stability, and reliability of monetisation flows, proactively identifying and resolving production issues that could impact revenue or user experience.

  • Support the development and optimisation of subscription and payment flows, including improvements to system performance, scalability, and error handling.

  • Implement and maintain feature flags, testing, and analytics instrumentation to support experimentation and continuous improvement of monetisation features.

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to build and improve analytics and reporting capabilities, providing insights into revenue performance, user behaviour, and system health.

Essential knowledge, skills & experience:

  • 5+ years of commercial backend development experience, ideally building high-load, business-critical systems.

  • Proven experience with mobile monetisation and subscription platforms, such as Adapty, RevenueCat, or comparable solutions.

  • Hands-on experience implementing mobile in-app purchases and subscription flows for iOS and/or Android applications, beyond web-based payment integrations.

  • Experience integrating mobile payment platforms with custom backend systems, including payment data synchronisation, receipt handling, subscription status tracking, and entitlement management.

  • Strong understanding of mobile subscription and payment lifecycles, including renewals, cancellations, refunds, failed payments, and subscription state changes.

  • Experience ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and consistency of revenue-critical backend systems, including troubleshooting production issues.

  • Strong backend development experience with Node.js or TypeScript or JavaScript, ideally using NestJS and building GraphQL or REST APIs.

  • Good understanding of event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and distributed systems.

  • Experience writing reliable unit and integration tests.

  • Strong technical ownership, independent problem-solving, and architectural decision-making skills, with the potential to take on technical leadership responsibilities.

  • Strong communication skills and full professional proficiency in English.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure, SQL and NoSQL databases. Our current stack includes ECS, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge, and PostgreSQL.

  • Experience working directly with Apple App Store and Google Play billing ecosystems.

  • Experience running monetisation experiments, including A/B testing, subscription pricing changes, and conversion optimisation.

  • Experience managing regional pricing, multiple currencies, and country-specific monetisation strategies.

  • Experience analysing the performance of monetisation experiments, including revenue, subscription conversion, and retention metrics.

  • Previous experience acting as a Tech Lead or Lead Backend Engineer, mentoring engineers, and driving technical decisions.

  3. Client technical interview

  4. Final interview

  5. Reference Check

title: Développeur Python IA
description: Développeur Python IA (H/F) Paris/Lille | Secteur Assurance Pourquoi cette opportunité ? Parce que vous participerez à la construction de notre stratégie d’intelligence artificielle, que nous sommes en train de définir. Vous rejoindrez une équipe motivée et talentueuse, dont la mission est d’intégrer l’IA au cœur de nos processus métier. L’objectif est de répondre aux besoins de nos équipes comme à ceux de nos clients, et d’automatiser certaines tâches à faible valeur ajoutée. Éléments clés Concevoir des solutions RAG et agentiques appliquées à des cas d’usage métier concrets. Développer et orchestrer des agents tout en assurant la traçabilité des sources et la maîtrise des hallucinations. Contribuer directement au workflow de paramétrage produit KELIA, avec une validation humaine intégrée aux étapes clés. Participer à la mise en production des assistants, de leur API jusqu’à leur intégration dans l’interface web interne. Ce qu’il faut savoir : Nous recherchons un(e) Développeur Python IA pour rejoindre notre équipe R&D à Paris ou Lille Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des solutions, de la conception jusqu’à la mise en production, en mobilisant différentes approches : modèles de langage (LLM), apprentissage supervisé, clustering et autres techniques de machine Learning. Un volet important de la mission concerne également le paramétrage produit : l’objectif est d’extraire les informations pertinentes des conditions générales, de proposer un paramétrage, de prévoir une validation par un expert à chaque étape et de produire un fichier directement importable dans KELIA. Missions principales : Vous développez en Python des fonctionnalités IA. Ingestion documentaire : extraire le texte et les tableaux des PDF, des pages Confluence, des documents SharePoint et des dépôts GitLab, puis découper, indexer et mettre à jour ces contenus avec des jobs asynchrones. Recherche : recherche hybride (sémantique et mots-clés), filtres par collection et par chemin, reranking, et recherche visuelle sur les pages de documents. Agents et LLM : développer des agents avec LangGraph (routage, recherche, filtrage, réflexion, réponse), écrire et versionner les prompts, citer les sources, et répondre « je ne trouve pas » quand l'information manque. Workflow de paramétrage produit : contribuer à l'agent qui extrait les informations des conditions générales, propose le paramétrage, fait valider chaque étape par un expert et produit un fichier importable dans KELIA. Qualité : maintenir des jeux de tests, mesurer le taux de bonnes réponses, suivre les réponses inventées et vérifier que les résultats sont stables d'un run à l'autre. Coût et latence : suivre la consommation de tokens, le temps de première réponse et le cache, et choisir le bon modèle pour chaque tâche. API : exposer les assistants en API, avec des réponses en streaming, et les intégrer à l'interface web interne. Documenter votre code, écrire des tests et participer aux revues de code. Ce poste est fait pour vous si: Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’un Bac+5 en informatique ou assurance Vous maîtrisez Python 3.11+ et êtes à l’aise avec le développement d’API via FastAPI , Pydantic et le streaming SSE . Vous avez une expérience ou un réel intérêt pour les solutions d’ IA générative , les LLM et les architectures agentiques avec LangChain , LangGraph et LiteLLM . Vous connaissez les principes de RAG , de recherche hybride, d’embeddings et de reranking, idéalement avec Qdrant . Vous savez travailler avec des sources documentaires variées et leur ingestion, notamment des PDF , Confluence , SharePoint ou GitLab , avec des outils tels que Docling . Vous êtes à l’aise avec les environnements de stockage et de persistance reposant sur PostgreSQL et le stockage objet S3 . Vous accordez de l’importance à l’observabilité et à la qualité des solutions IA, notamment au suivi des prompts, des traces, des logs, des coûts et des performances, avec des outils comme MLflow . Vous êtes sensibilisé aux enjeux de sécurité, d’authentification et de gestion des rôles, notamment avec Keycloak . Vous évoluez avec aisance dans un environnement d’industrialisation moderne utilisant Git , GitLab CI , Docker , Kubernetes , Helm et pytest , ainsi que des outils collaboratifs comme Jira et Confluence . Ce que vous apportez Une bonne maîtrise de Python et de ses bonnes pratiques : tests (pytest), typage, gestion des dépendances. Votre expérience dans l’utilisation des API de LLM et bases du prompt engineering, y compris les sorties structurées. Votre compréhension du fonctionnement d'un RAG : embeddings, découpage, recherche, génération. Une bonne maîtrise du SQL et notions de bases de données. Git et travail en équipe. Pourquoi nous joindre: Pour contribuer à une stratégie où l’intelligence artificielle est un levier clé de la feuille de route technologique, avec des solutions intégrées au cœur des outils métiers. Pour travailler sur des cas d’usage concrets d’IA générative, de RAG et d’agents LLM, de l’expérimentation jusqu’à l’industrialisation. Pour associer des technologies IA de pointe à une expertise métier forte dans le secteur de l’assurance et créer des solutions à impact réel. Prêt(e) à démarrer une nouvelle expérience ? title: Office Manager / Office Operations Support (w/m/d)
description: Über IONOS Bei IONOS verwalten wir nicht nur Server, wir prägen mit unseren Lösungen die digitale Zukunft für über 6,2 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit. Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools. Was uns antreibt: Digitale Entscheidungsfreiheit für Europa und echter Impact für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) sowie Großunternehmen. Wir arbeiten in agilen Teams, setzen auf transparente Strukturen und glauben daran, dass Exzellenz und Innovation nur mit echtem Teamgeist entstehen. Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns. Aufgabenbereich Bei IONOS bringst Du täglich Ordnung in die Dinge, die zählen – und das buchstäblich. Als Office Manager oder Office Operations Support bist Du das Herzstück unseres Büros: die erste Anlaufstelle für Kolleg:innen, Dienstleister und Gäste. Du schaffst eine Arbeitsumgebung, in der sich alle wohlfühlen, Prozesse reibungslos laufen und nichts dem Zufall überlassen wird. Empfang & Gästebetreuung: Du bist das freundliche Gesicht unseres Unternehmens – Du empfängst Gäste und Besucher:innen professionell, koordinierst Meetingräume und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden jederzeit einen gut organisierten Anlaufpunkt vorfinden. Büroorganisation & Logistik: Du planst und optimierst eigenständig die Bestände an Büromaterialien, Verbrauchsgütern und Cateringartikeln (Kaffee, Getränke, Snacks, Sanitärprodukte) – mit Blick auf Effizienz und Verfügbarkeit. Außerdem koordinierst Du die gesamte ein- und ausgehende Paket- und Postlogistik, einschließlich komplexer Sendungen und IT-Hardware-Versand. Infrastruktur & Facility Management: Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zum Gebäudemanagement und zu externen Dienstleistern: Du überwachst Wartungspläne, koordinierst Reparaturen und sorgst dafür, dass unser Büro stets in einwandfreiem Zustand ist. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit dem Einkauf zusammen und bringst Deine operativen Anforderungen proaktiv ein. Zugangsverwaltung: Du pflegst Zugangssysteme, aktualisierst Sitzpläne und unterstützt HR aktiv bei On- und Offboarding-Prozessen durch die Einrichtung und Verwaltung von Zugangsberechtigungen. Arbeitssicherheit & Events: Du trägst aktiv zur Einhaltung von Arbeitsschutz- und Brandschutzanforderungen bei und arbeitest dabei eng mit der Sicherheitsbeauftragten zusammen. Darüber hinaus planst und koordinierst Du interne Events, All-Hands-Meetings, Partys und externe Konferenzen. Qualifikationen Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens 1–3 Jahre nachweisbare Berufserfahrung im Office Management, Facility Management, Front Office oder in einer vergleichbaren administrativen Funktion. Prozess- & Organisationsverständnis: Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich, verstehst betriebliche Abläufe und hast ein gutes Gespür für effiziente Bestands- und Wartungsplanung. Serviceorientierung & Hands-on-Mentalität: Du bist bekannt für Deine hohe Kunden- und Mitarbeiterorientierung – Du packst an, wo es gebraucht wird, und findest auch in unerwarteten Situationen pragmatische Lösungen. Digitale Kompetenz: Du arbeitest sicher mit modernen Office-Tools und hast grundsätzliche Offenheit gegenüber digitalen Arbeitsmitteln, Automatisierungsansätzen und neuen Systemen. Kommunikation & Compliance: Du kommunizierst klar und professionell auf Deutsch (Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil) und verfügst über Grundkenntnisse im Bereich Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit. Persönlichkeit: Du bist teamorientiert, zuverlässig und bringst ausgezeichnete Organisations- und Multitasking-Fähigkeiten mit. Flexibilität, Detailgenauigkeit und Lösungsorientierung sind für Dich selbstverständlich. Benefits Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit. An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke. Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung. Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte. Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops. Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse. raw.title: Software Engineer, Backend (BI Platform)
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale.

We're looking for a Software Engineer, Backend to join our London team. This role is based in our London office with a hybrid setup, typically 3 days in the office.

Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

 

About the Team

The Core BI team builds and operates the services, integrations and automation that power business intelligence across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. Our platforms help analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers and business teams discover trusted data and make informed decisions at scale.

We combine software engineering, platform ownership, and a strong user focus to make BI tooling reliable, secure, scalable and self-service. The team supports the current BI ecosystem while helping shape a more integrated experience across the DoorDash group.

 

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on the Core BI team, you will build and operate the backend services, APIs and infrastructure our BI platforms run on. This is a hands-on software and platform engineering role: services and integrations, identity and access automation, observability, reliability and developer experience. BI is the domain you serve (primarily Looker and Sigma, and the systems around them), but the problems are backend and platform problems.

You will own problems from discovery through design, implementation, deployment, and operational support. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Product Managers and business teams to turn recurring user needs into durable, self-service capabilities. If you're energized by solving technical problems with data and comfortable being deeply embedded across several domains, this role is for you!

 

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Design, build, test, deploy and operate the backend services, APIs and automation that the BI platforms across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt depend on

  • Automate the platform lifecycle end to end (provisioning, metadata, permissions, migrations, archival and validation) so administration stops being manual work

  • Build the integrations between BI platforms and the wider ecosystem: warehouses, identity providers, orchestration, CI/CD and internal developer tooling

  • Improve the availability, observability, performance, scalability and security of the systems you own, and carry them in production

  • Use AI tooling as part of how you engineer, and where it fits, build LLM-backed capabilities held to the same reliability and governance bar as anything else we ship

  • Raise the engineering bar on the team, from service design and code review to testing, CI/CD and documentation, and improve the developer experience for everyone building on the platform

We're excited about you because…

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend, platform or infrastructure systems

  • Readable, maintainable, well-tested code in Python, plus comfort with SQL and a working understanding of data modelling and warehousing concepts

  • Experience building and owning APIs, integrations or automation in production, with sound judgement on service boundaries, authentication, data contracts and failure modes

  • Hands-on with CI/CD, containers and Kubernetes, observability, debugging and incident response, and you expect to operate what you build

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (LLMs, agentic workflows, AI-assisted development) as part of how you engineer, and judgement about where they help and where they do not

  • End-to-end ownership of ambiguous problems, clear communication with technical and non-technical teams, and comfort self-organising in a fast-paced, distributed environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience owning or integrating with BI platforms such as Looker, Sigma or comparable tools, and familiarity with semantic layers such as LookML or dbt

  • Experience automating identity and access through Okta, SCIM or role-based access controls, or building multi-tenant platforms across brands and regions

  • Experience shipping LLM-backed features to real users (retrieval, grounding and evaluation), or with MCP, agent frameworks or tool-calling in production

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide here to help you feel confident at each stage.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

description: About SuperchargeMe SuperchargeMe is one brain for the whole commerce business. Ten products, Ads-IQ, Retention-IQ, Restock-IQ, Stores-IQ, Marketplaces-IQ, Crossborder-IQ, NPD-IQ, Concierge-IQ, Feeds-IQ and Partnership-IQ, share one set of numbers. They don't stop at recommendations: they make the changes too, at the level of control each brand chooses. It works inside Slack, plugs into 100+ tools from Shopify and NetSuite to Meta, Google and Amazon, and is running 23 brands today across paid media, retention, inventory and wholesale, stores, marketplaces, catalog and partnerships. Every function has a tool. Nothing runs the whole. We built SuperchargeMe to run the whole. The product is live and brands are paying for it. Getting it in front of the right brands is the next step. That's you. The role in a sentence Be our first marketer and own the go-to-market: fill the sales calendar with CEOs, CFOs, COOs, CMOs and VPs of E-Commerce at mid-market omnichannel brands, and grow the brands that sign up on their own. Where we are SuperchargeMe is already revenue-generating, with brands paying for it every month. What it doesn't have yet is a way for the next hundred brands to find it. Who we sell to: mid-market omnichannel brands in the US, UK and EU, selling across their own store, marketplaces, wholesale and retail. Two ways in: brands starting with a single product sign up and get going on their own. Brands that want several platforms working together, with onboarding, book a demo. There's no marketing team, agency or playbook yet. You start with a live website, a sales deck, a product you can demo, and case studies from our first clients that are being written now. A founding Account Executive starts alongside you, so every demo you book has a closer waiting, while sign-ups go straight into the product. The story is ready to tell. Brands run ten to twenty tools, each now with its own AI, and none of them agree. We call it the Silo Tax. Naming it, and making brand leaders feel it, is the heart of this job. The work Set the go-to-market plan: which buyers and markets we go after first, and through which channels. Run paid media yourself across Meta, Google, LinkedIn and anything else that works, alongside email, retargeting, campaigns aimed at named brands, events, and joint marketing with agencies, Shopify partners and systems integrators. Work out which of our ten products to lead with for each type of buyer, and write the messaging for each. Build and look after the route to a demo: landing pages, the booking flow, qualifying questions, quick follow-up and a clean handover to sales. Grow self-serve sign-ups, from the first visit to an account that's actually using the product, including our Shopify App Store listing. Turn our case studies and the founders' experience into posts, pages and short videos. Use our own agents on your campaigns, starting with Ads-IQ on Google and Meta. Report every week on demos, sign-ups, activation, pipeline and what each one cost. What good looks like We'll measure you on qualified demos and sign-ups, and the revenue they lead to. Clicks, impressions and ROAS only matter as far as they get us there. After your first month, tracking is set up properly, you've agreed the list of target brands with sales, and your first campaign is running. After your first quarter, demos and sign-ups come in every week from channels you set up, and you know what each one costs by channel. Sales starts asking for more of one kind of lead, because those are the deals that close. The case studies already being written with our first clients are published, and sales uses them in every deal. What you bring At least four years in B2B demand generation or growth, ideally at a software company selling to e-commerce or retail brands. You've run Meta, Google and LinkedIn campaigns yourself, including campaigns aimed at a list of named companies, without an agency doing it for you. You can show the pipeline or sign-ups you've been responsible for, and what they cost. You write well enough that a CMO reads to the end. You build your own reporting in the CRM and analytics tools. You already use AI tools and agents in your day-to-day work and can show us how. We sell AI agents, so we'd expect that. You're comfortable being the first and only marketer for a while. Bonus points You've run a DTC or e-commerce brand. You've built demand from zero at an early-stage B2B company. You've run events or executive dinners in commerce or retail. Skip this one if Your best campaigns needed an agency to run them. You report clicks and impressions and call it pipeline. You'd rather write the plan than ship the campaign. You want a remote or mostly remote role. We're together in North London Monday to Thursday. Why join You'll set up marketing from scratch, and you'll have a say in who joins the team after you. Most brand leaders haven't yet seen AI that takes actions on their business. You'll shape how they first hear about it. You'll work alongside both founders, who ran commerce brands before building software. Decisions are quick, and what you hear from the market gets into the product fast. You can use our agents on your own work from your first day. How we hire A 30-minute intro call with the co-founders. A short exercise: a one-page plan for getting qualified demos from mid-market omnichannel brands and growing sign-ups. A working session with the founders on your plan. References. Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap. Pour plus d’information sur l’association : www.hi.org DESCRIPTION DE POSTE : Le stage se déroulera au sein du Pôle Qualité de Vie et Conditions de Travail à la direction des Ressources Humaines de Handicap International, avec un démarrage mi-janvier pour une durée de 6 mois. Le pôle est constitué d’une référente santé/handicap et d’une manager QVCT/prévention des risques psycho sociaux. Nous travaillons avec des acteurs externes (médecin du travail, assistante sociale, psychologues, courtiers). A noter le tutorat sera exercé par un RH et non un psychologue. L'objectif de l'équipe QVCT est de mettre en œuvre et de coordonner la politique de protection du personnel de l'organisation afin de garantir la bonne santé psychologique et physique de tous ses employés. Das Team hilft Unternehmen dabei, aus ihren Daten echten Mehrwert zu machen: von der ersten KI-Strategie über moderne Lakehouse-Plattformen bis hin zu Machine-Learning- und Agentic-AI-Lösungen, die im Alltag tatsächlich laufen. Und nicht nur auf Folien gut aussehen.

Was Datasolut macht:Datasolut begleitet seine Kunden auf dem ganzen Weg: gemeinsam verstehen, wo sie stehen, umsetzen, was wirklich gebraucht wird, und skalieren, was funktioniert. Strategie und Umsetzung kommen aus einer Hand. Kein Übergeben, kein Neu-Erklären, kein Stille-Post-Spiel.Technologisch ist Datasolut ganz vorne mit dabei: Als Databricks Silver Partner und einer der wenigen Microsoft Fabric Featured Partner in Deutschland arbeitest du mit den Plattformen, die gerade die Datenwelt prägen. CTO Laurenz ist Databricks MVP. Heißt für dich: Hier lernst du von Leuten, die wissen, wovon sie reden.

So arbeitet das Team:Datasolut ist kein Konzern, und das ist auch gut so. Es gibt kurze Wege, flache Hierarchien und echte Verantwortung von Anfang an. Deine Ideen landen nicht in einer Schublade, sondern im nächsten Projekt. Das Team teilt Wissen, hilft sich gegenseitig weiter und feiert Erfolge gemeinsam.

Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich! Wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen und dich mit Datasolut zusammenzubringen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust für unsere Kunden Cloud-Infrastrukturen und -Ressourcen in Microsoft Azure auf, verbindest Netzwerke und Datenquellen und bettest alles sauber in das Gesamtkonstrukt ein.

  • Du setzt Infrastructure as Code mit Terraform selbst um, inklusive Deployments, und sorgst mit CI/CD für saubere und robuste Prozesse.

  • Du führst das wachsende Cloud-Team mit aktuell drei Engineers fachlich.

  • Du baust Standards und Best Practices für die Cloud-Projekte auf, damit bei jedem Kunden schneller und verlässlicher geliefert wird.

  • Du entwickelst den Bereich Cloud weiter, bringst neue Impulse in unser Angebot ein und erkennst Potenziale bei unseren Kunden.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Data & AI Engineers zusammen, damit Cloud-Infrastruktur, Datenplattformen wie Databricks und KI-Lösungen nahtlos zusammenspielen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • 4 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Cloud Engineering, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft Azure.

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, insbesondere Terraform, sowie mit CI/CD und DevOps-Prinzipien.

  • Gutes Verständnis von Netzwerken, Security und der Anbindung von Datenquellen in Cloud-Umgebungen.

  • Erfahrung mit Databricks ist ein großes Plus. Kenntnisse in AWS oder Snowflake sind ebenfalls willkommen.

  • Beratungserfahrung ist sehr wünschenswert. Vor allem solltest du Bock auf Kundenkontakt haben.

  • Führungserfahrung ist kein Muss. Wichtig ist, dass du Lust hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und andere fachlich weiterzubringen.

  • Organisationstalent und Kommunikationsstärke: Du behältst den Überblick und erklärst komplexe Themen verständlich; im Team genauso wie gegenüber Nicht-Techies.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Muttersprache oder C1-Niveau mit Nachweis) und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Das bekommst du

  • Projekte mit echtem Impact statt Beschäftigungstherapie

  • Arbeiten mit modernsten Data- & AI-Technologien wie Databricks und Microsoft Fabric

  • Ein Team, das Bock auf Daten hat und dich mitzieht

  • Raum zum Lernen, Ausprobieren und Wachsen

  • Wahl zwischen JobRad und Deutschlandticket (Urban Sports Club folgt bald!)

  • 3 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche

  • Modernes Office mit zwei Büroflächen im Herzen von Köln-Ehrenfeld - viele Restaurants für die Mittagspause sind fußläufig erreichbar

  • Eigenes Gym im Office und alle 2 Wochen dienstags nach Feierabend Training mit unserer Personal Trainerin

  • Siebträgermaschine für richtig guten Kaffee

Warum Datasolut?

Als hochmotiviertes Team sind für Datasolut gute Zusammenarbeit, Transparenz und offene Kommunikation sehr wichtig. Das Team besteht aus echten Machern mit starken Meinungen, die sich trotzdem nicht zu ernst nehmen.

Die Projekte sind in der Regel auf den Großraum Köln fokussiert, lange Reisezeiten werden also möglichst vermieden. Datasolut legt sehr viel Wert auf ein starkes Team und versucht, Projekteinsätze wenn möglich gemeinsam als Team zu lösen. Neben der Arbeit bei Kunden ist es Datasolut wichtig, interne Projekte und innovative Datenprodukte voranzutreiben.

title: Senior Associate, Investor Services
description:
Pantheon has been at the forefront of private markets investing for more than 40 years, earning a reputation for an innovative approach to investing in secondaries, co-investments, and primary fund investments, as well as capital formation across commingled funds, evergreen vehicles and customized solutions. Our specialist investment capabilities span multiple strategies across private equity, infrastructure and real assets, and private credit. Through our collaborative and committed culture, we find new ways to solve complex problems together and deliver innovative investment opportunities across private markets. Pantheon currently manages approximately $82.3 billion in AUM across all its strategies, serving more than 750 institutional and 638 private wealth clients worldwide

For further details please visit www.pantheon.com

Purpose of Position

Reporting to the Head of Global Investor Services, the Investor Services Senior Associate is a senior operational role responsible for improving the end to-end client experience and strengthening the effectiveness of the Client Solutions function. The role combines client service delivery, process ownership, data governance, systems improvement and line management of one Analyst within the Investor Services team. Working as part of the global client solutions team, the Senior Associate will act as a key coordination point between Investor Services, Client Solutions, internal specialist functions and external service providers. The role will require close collaboration across the business and with third-party partners to support client lifecycle activity, regulatory and tax documentation, due diligence, screening and process improvement. It will also contribute to the continued development and integration of client-facing and internal systems, including the CRM and Investor Portal.

Key Responsibilities

  • Represent Investor Services and client requirements in internal forums, working groups and cross-functional initiatives focused on improving global client processes and service delivery. 
  • Partner with the Head of Global Investor Services and the Change Office to identify, plan and deliver local and global projects that simplify, improve and automate client service activity
  • Support the development of the Investor Services Analyst by setting clear objectives, providing guidance and feedback, sharing knowledge, and helping to build capability across the team.

Client Process and Service Delivery

  • Manage and execute core client lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, transfers of interest, fund extensions, fund terminations, tax repapering, KYC refreshes and World-Check activity.
  • Liaise with external fund administrators, tax consultants, and compliance service providers to coordinate client documentation, due diligence, screening and related process activity.
  • Maintain oversight of global client service activity to ensure processes are consistent, well controlled and aligned with business requirements.
  • Triage non-standard internal client data requests and client-related projects, ensuring priorities, ownership and next steps are clear.
  • Oversee ad-hoc client communications and administrative activity where central coordination is required.

Client Experience and Reporting

  • Drive improvements to global client processes, identifying opportunities to make the client experience more consistent, efficient and scalable.
  • Produce, maintain and coordinate delivery of the global client service plan.
  • Partner with Reporting to improve client support, maintain reporting standards and contribute to continued reporting development.
  • Automation of Tier 3 client support.

Systems, Data and Process Improvement

  • Partner with Technology teams and the Change Office to drive developments and integration of existing client facing and internal IR support systems
  • Identify Investor and Client Solutions processes for systemization and integration

Knowledge and Experience Required

  • Degree-level education (or equivalent experience) is essential
  • Strong knowledge of asset management and the private markets industry, including investor servicing, fund operations and the client lifecycle.
  • Direct experience in client service or investor-facing support, with a strong understanding of how to deliver a high-quality client experience.
  • Familiarity with client due diligence, KYC refreshes, tax documentation processes and screening tools such as World-Check would be advantageous.
  • Proven ability to build relationships, influence stakeholders and work effectively across functions and seniority levels.
  • Experience delivering short and long-term projects, with evidence of clear outcomes, strong execution and practical process improvement.
  • Experience supporting, coaching or managing team members, including setting objectives and providing constructive feedback.
  • High levels of professionalism, confidentiality, discretion and judgement when handling client, investor and business information.
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, work under pressure and deliver to deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly and adapt messaging for different audiences.
  • Strong systems capability, including proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and CRM platforms; experience with investor portals or data management tools would be advantageous.

 

This job description is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. You may be required to perform other job-related duties as reasonably requested by your manager.

  • Advanced discovery, negotiation, and value-based selling skills.

description:
Overview 

Alnylam Pharmaceuticals is seeking an imaginative physician drug developer, with the flexibility and confidence to work across diseases within the neurology and hematology therapeutic area.  This role includes the opportunity to provide clinical leadership in developing RNAi therapeutics in Alnylam’s expanding portfolio, which spans from rare genetic to common diseases.

The successful candidate’s primary role will be one of the clinical study leads working on the plasminogen program transitioning from Phase 2 to Phase 3. The Director will report directly into the program clinical development strategy lead who provides the clinical research oversight of the program. The Director is expected to play a leading and influencing role in the overall clinical development strategies and drive progress and operational excellence of his/her clinical trial(s). This work will also involve extensive consultation and collaboration with external experts. The Director, Clinical Research, will work in a matrix organization across Regulatory, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, Preclinical, Commercial & Quality Assurance teams to ensure fully harmonized and integrated development strategies. The Director will be a key Alnylam Development spokesperson at external meetings, including regulatory interactions and scientific meetings.

 Key Responsibilities 

  • Be a subject matter expert for the relevant disease area(s)
  • Be the strategic leader providing a strong, clear voice for the clinical program
  • Develop creative but realistic approaches to drug development and lead clinical efforts towards global regulatory approvals
  • Oversight of trial conduct and safety
  • Collaborate closely with Preclinical, Regulatory Affairs and Medical Affairs to ensure tight strategic integration of product development plans.
  • Be accountable via Clinical Research and Operations for all relevant timelines and deliverables.
  • Supervise closely all major written deliverables (regulatory submissions, original articles, abstracts), and presentation materials.
  • Be responsible for final review and sign off with respect to all controlled documents including protocols, investigator brochures, and informed consent forms.
  • Influence internal and external audiences in a high impact, highly visible fashion  

Qualifications

A highly driven, dynamic, engaged and accomplished physician-scientist with experience and insight will thrive in this role. Specific qualifications include:

  • MD with strong research background or MD PhD with best of class clinical and/or research training as shown through research support and peer-reviewed publications.
  • Board Certification (or equivalent) or specialist training in hematology is desirable
  • 3+ years industry experience or equivalent clinical academic research experience
  • Sound scientific and clinical judgment
  • Familiarity with concepts of clinical research and clinical trials, including biostatistics, and regulatory agency organization, guidelines, and practices
  • Ability to effectively present ideas and document complex medical/clinical concepts in both written and oral communication
  • History of critical thinking and problem solving while exhibiting superior judgment and a balanced, realistic understanding of issues
  • Outstanding leadership and collaboration skills working within a matrix environment

description: What we're building Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future. Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI . One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available ( paper ). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact ( paper ) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise. Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright. This is at the core of Genesis AI's strategy . Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute. The role You push the physics of Genesis-World forward. The mandate is clear: ship production-ready simulation capabilities that matter for the company's internal needs. Research applied end-to-end, from algorithm to merged, tested, documented code that real robot-learning pipelines depend on. Occasional groundbreaking research happens, notably through academic collaborations. But the core of the job is making the engine measurably better along five axes: Speed. Algorithms that are not only faster but also smart enough to spend compute only where it matters across both time and space: larger stable timesteps, selective fidelity (adaptive across scales or simply hand-set), structure-aware solvers. Completeness. No physics off limits: water, human animation, air flow, gravel, tendons, even body organs. Whatever the next use-case needs, the engine grows to cover it. Fidelity. More realistic models: contact, friction, deformation, energy, actuation, materials… Versatility. Extensible multi-physics without compromise on realism: all solvers in the scene coupled together at once, two-way and constraint-based. Write your own solver and it joins the scene like a native one, growing into an open solver ecosystem. Scalability. From workstation to factory scale, and one day, city scale: thousands of interacting entities, batched across environments, without losing physical soundness. Our ambition is to establish Genesis-World as the go-to simulator for physical AI, from companies and research labs to individuals. The problems waiting for you Every fidelity for every physics. The same physics at every point of the speed-accuracy spectrum, from heavily batched training with XPBD or VBD to final validation with IPC. Same scene, same API, pick your tradeoff. Invent physics level-of-detail (LOD). Rendering has had LOD for decades, physics is still waiting. Simulate at full fidelity what agents interact with and see, coarsely what they do not. Heterogeneous environments. Every parallel world can hold a completely different model: different bodies, joints, and collision geometries. Adaptive timesteps per island. Error-based control with Runge-Kutta Dopri5, and Time-of-Impact stepping during collision detection, as done in Jiminy. Couple everything, exactly. raw.description:
What we're building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

This is at the core of Genesis AI's strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute.

The role

You push the physics of Genesis-World forward. The mandate is clear: ship production-ready simulation capabilities that matter for the company's internal needs. Research applied end-to-end, from algorithm to merged, tested, documented code that real robot-learning pipelines depend on. Occasional groundbreaking research happens, notably through academic collaborations. But the core of the job is making the engine measurably better along five axes:

  • Speed. Algorithms that are not only faster but also smart enough to spend compute only where it matters across both time and space: larger stable timesteps, selective fidelity (adaptive across scales or simply hand-set), structure-aware solvers.

  • Completeness. No physics off limits: water, human animation, air flow, gravel, tendons, even body organs. Whatever the next use-case needs, the engine grows to cover it.

  • Fidelity. More realistic models: contact, friction, deformation, energy, actuation, materials…

  • Versatility. Extensible multi-physics without compromise on realism: all solvers in the scene coupled together at once, two-way and constraint-based. Write your own solver and it joins the scene like a native one, growing into an open solver ecosystem.

  • Scalability. From workstation to factory scale, and one day, city scale: thousands of interacting entities, batched across environments, without losing physical soundness.

Our ambition is to establish Genesis-World as the go-to simulator for physical AI, from companies and research labs to individuals.

The problems waiting for you

  • Every fidelity for every physics. The same physics at every point of the speed-accuracy spectrum, from heavily batched training with XPBD or VBD to final validation with IPC. Same scene, same API, pick your tradeoff.

  • Invent physics level-of-detail (LOD). Rendering has had LOD for decades, physics is still waiting. Simulate at full fidelity what agents interact with and see, coarsely what they do not.

  • Heterogeneous environments. Every parallel world can hold a completely different model: different bodies, joints, and collision geometries.

  • Adaptive timesteps per island. Error-based control with Runge-Kutta Dopri5, and Time-of-Impact stepping during collision detection, as done in Jiminy.

  • Couple everything, exactly. Efficient and accurate two-way constraint-based coupling between heterogeneous grey-box solvers, using state-of-the-art methods like ADMM. Owning every solver in the stack is what makes it possible.

  • More scalable constraint solvers. Push rigid constraint solving beyond its current scalability ceiling (reference).

  • Unify contact resolution. Hydro-elastic compliance, unilateral constraints, and sequential impulses in the same framework, ideally under one generic formulation.

  • Closed kinematic loops without constraints. Handle loops intrinsically for numerical stability and speed, in the spirit of Kamino.

Day to day: you write your physics in plain Python and Quadrants makes it fast on every backend. And you validate it the hard way: analytical closed forms, other engines, real-world data.

Who you are

You are a physicist and an engineer at once. You judge a method by whether it holds up in production at real scale, and you do not stop until it does. No blind spots: you relentlessly hunt down even the defect that looks insignificant, because it never is.

  • A strong background in physics-based simulation, preferably related to robotics: RBD, FEM, MPM, SPH, IPC, XPBD, VBD, ABD, plus constrained optimization and numerical integration of stiff systems.

  • A track record of shipping simulation code that others rely on, in an engine, in industry, or in a research codebase used beyond its authors.

  • Solid HPC programming (CPU and/or GPU), and an instinct for what makes a numerical method fast in practice, beyond complexity classes.

  • Rigor in validation: analytical closed forms, cross-engine consistency, real-world data.

title: Senior Corporate Recruiter
description:
Your Role in Our Story: 

 

As a Senior Recruiter at ACT, you will attract and hire commercial talent, primarily -and not alone- for our Front Office teams. You will manage the recruitment process from intake to offer, working closely with hiring managers to understand their business, challenge requirements and turn hiring needs into effective recruitment strategies.

You understand our markets and what motivates people working in environmental commodities, energy and trading. You use this knowledge to identify talent, build relationships and give practical advice on how to attract the right candidates.

 

  • Own the full recruitment cycle, primarily for Front Office positions, including sales, trading and business development.

  • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, agree on selection criteria and keep recruitment moving.

  • Proactively source and engage candidates, building talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

  • Bring market knowledge into hiring discussions, advising on talent availability, competitor activity and candidate expectations.

  • Conduct thorough interviews and support objective, consistent hiring decisions.

  • Deliver a positive candidate experience through clear communication, timely feedback and careful follow-up.

  • Keep Greenhouse accurate and up to date, using recruitment data to identify bottlenecks and improve results.

  • Work closely with fellow recruiters, HR and Employer Branding, sharing knowledge and contributing to team priorities.

 

Your Expertise: 

To be successful in this role, we are looking for candidates with the following qualifications and attributes:

  • 3–5 years of recruitment experience, with a strong track record of hiring for commercial or Front Office positions.

  • Knowledge of environmental commodities, energy, trading or closely related financial and commodity markets.

  • Strong sourcing skills and experience engaging passive candidates in competitive international markets.

  • Confidence working with hiring managers, offering practical advice and respectfully challenging assumptions.

  • An eager, proactive approach: you take initiative, spot opportunities and follow through.

  • A collaborative mindset: you share insights, support colleagues and take responsibility for team results.

  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage several vacancies and changing priorities.

  • Experience using an ATS, preferably Greenhouse, and an interest in applying recruitment technology and AI effectively.

  • Excellent communication skills in English and the ability to connect with people across different cultures and backgrounds.

 

If you meet these criteria and are ready to contribute your expertise to a dynamic and challenging environment, we encourage you to apply.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field
  • Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts
