Software is not just vital but a strategic cornerstone of our operations. We’re looking for a Product Designer to set the cross-application UX direction for our commercial software - from pharma cold-chain visibility that helps temperature-sensitive medicines move safely around the world, to ULD tracking for airlines. You’ll define a consistent, high-quality experience across our modules and applications and support our specialised designers in bringing that experience to life, while remaining hands-on in discovery, from the first user conversation through to the final UX.

📍 Location: We are open to candidates based anywhere within the UK, Spain, and the Netherlands, with remote working available within these countries. Hybrid option available in the Netherlands.

Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions.

Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide.

Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains.

Why SkyCell?

🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare.

🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation.

🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way.

💡 Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in our people – continuous learning and development are key pillars of SkyCell.

🏆 Award-Winning Culture: Join a workplace recognized for its commitment to excellence with a ‘Great Place to work’ award, as well as a Platinum Ecovadis rating highlighting our sustainability and employee well-being.

What You'll Do:

A dedicated framework team owns our Design System and Design Guidelines, while embedded designers craft the screens and flows within each product module. Your role is to set the overall direction for the experience they design towards — including experience principles, end-to-end journeys and measurable outcomes that help multiple modules feel like one product.

You will:

  • Lead discovery end-to-end, including user research and interviews, journey mapping, jobs-to-be-done, pain points and opportunities, and translate research into a shared foundation for UX and product decisions

  • Create wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes hands-on using Figma and/or code to explore and test concepts during discovery, and run evaluative tests with users and engineers

  • Define the cross-application UX vision, design principles and success metrics together with Product and Marketing

  • Support and align our specialised designers - framework and embedded - around a consistent experience across modules and applications

  • Communicate UX principles and investment priorities to senior leadership, demonstrating the value and potential impact of UX-related roadmap items

  • Maintain the UX roadmap and prioritise pattern and design investments with the framework team

  • Produce high-level experience flows and service blueprints that connect journeys across applications and domains

  • Review Design System and module deliverables for alignment with experience strategy and brand

  • Support embedded designers from discovery through to delivery by co-framing problems, reviewing flows against the cross-application blueprint and ensuring continuity across user journeys

  • Set KPIs and use analytics, user research, A/B tests and competitive analysis to inform and refine design decisions

  • Promote a UX culture centred on user needs, inclusive design and accessibility standards such as WCAG across the organisation

  • Collaborate with Marketing on tone, terminology and brand consistency across products


What You'll Bring:

  • Degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Experience as a senior or lead product designer working on complex B2B software, ideally within supply chain, logistics, aviation/air cargo or pharma

  • Strong experience leading discovery, from understanding user needs through research and prototyping to defining and refining UX solutions

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, with experience creating and iterating wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes

  • Experience bringing together multiple designers, including without formal reporting lines, to create a consistent experience across products or modules

  • Ability to communicate UX strategy, priorities and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders

  • Working knowledge of design systems and accessibility standards such as WCAG; experience partnering with design system teams is an advantage

  • Experience designing for multiple user groups, such as pharma quality/logistics teams and airline cargo operations, is beneficial

If you don’t meet every requirement but bring relevant experience and skills, we’d still like to hear from you.

What's In It For You?

⚡ Flexibility & Balance: Flexible working hours and work-life balance allow you to tailor work to fit your life.

🌟 Recognition & Growth: Opportunities for career advancement in a company that values your contributions.

🌍 Flexible ways of working: Our global teams work across our offices in Zurich, Zug, Hyderabad and Basel, with a mix of on-site, hybrid and remote working. Role-specific locations and working arrangements are detailed above.

🎉 Company-wide Events: Join us for company events to celebrate successes, build teams, and share our vision. Plus, new joiners experience SkyWeek, our immersive onboarding program.

👶 Generous Maternity & Paternity Leave: Support for new parents with competitive maternity and paternity leave.

🏖️ Annual Leave & Bank Holidays: Enjoy a generous annual leave package, plus local bank holidays to recharge and unwind.

Du entwickelst und vermarktest digitale Services, die unsere Kunden begeistern und unser Geschäftsmodell transformieren. Mit deinem Gespür für Marktpotenziale und deinem strategischen Denken baust du neue digitale Geschäftsfelder auf, datenbasiert, skalierbar und kundenorientiert.

Dein zukünftiges Wirkungsfeld

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Go-to-Market-Strategien für digitale Produkte und Services in enger Abstimmung mit Produkt Owners/Management innerhalb von Rychiger
  • Aufbau und Skalierung von Business- und Use Cases (Subscription, Value-based Pricing, Success Sharing) auf Grundlage einer – zu definierenden – Roadmap von digitalen Services
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb, Marketing, Key- Accounts (insbes. von strategischen Schlüsselkunden), Entwicklung und Kunden zur Co-Creation und erfolgreichen Markteinführung
  • Durchführung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen sowie proaktives Erkennen relevanter Trends und Entwicklungen
  • Führung von Kundengesprächen, um die Produktentwicklung mit den Bedürfnissen des Marktes resp. der Industrie/Branche abzustimmen
  • Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen für Unternehmensleitung, Vertrieb, Entwicklung, Aftersales und (IT/OT) Infrastruktur über den gesamten Lebenszyklus inklusive Produktpflege und Preisgestaltung
  • Positionierung unserer digitalen Services im Markt, inkl. Storytelling, Value Proposition und Differenzierung
  • Planung und (technische) Begleitung/Unterstützung von Pilot-Installationen bei Kunden

Weshalb dir das gelingt

  • Abgeschlossene technische Grundausbildung mit Weiterbildung als Ingenieur FH/Uni, betriebswirtschaftliche Zusatzausbildung von Vorteil
  • Nachweislicher Trackrecord im Produktmanagement, Business Development oder Marketing digitaler Lösungen, idealerweise im industriellen Umfeld mit internationaler Ausrichtung
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis für Kunden im industriellen Umfeld inkl. der praxisorientierten Anwendung von AI, sowohl aufgrund von Prozessdaten (ML/DL) als auch der Wertschöpfung
  • Erweitertes Verständnis für Maschinenbau, IIoT und datengetriebene Geschäftsmodelle sowie ausgeprägte Kreativität und Innovationsfreude
  • Hands-on, pragmatisch, umsetzungsstark, ausgeprägtes strategisches Denken und ein hohes Mass an Eigeninitiative
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1), weitere Sprachen von Vorteil
  • Reisebereitschaft von rund 20 Prozent

Was wir dazu beitragen

  • Ein innovationsfreundliches Umfeld mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Direkter Einfluss auf die digitale Transformation eines führenden Maschinenbauunternehmens
  • Zusammenarbeit mit engagierten Kolleg*innen und internationalen Kunden
  • Moderne Arbeitsweise, flexible Strukturen und klare Ambitionen
  • Förderung und individuelle Weiterentwicklung mit vielseitigen Aus-/Weiterbildungsangeboten
  • Gewinnbeteiligungen und attraktive Optionen im Rahmen der Pensionskasse
  • Fitness-Studio, Ruheräume, Foodlounge, internes Care & Case Management

title: Cloud Engineer
description: Headquarters: US URL: https://knack.com Location: US Based (Full-Time, Remote) or International Contractor (Full-Time, Remote) If US-Based: This will be a remote position based in the United States. Knack offers a complete benefits package to those working in the United States. Employees must be available during standard US business hours and maintain their primary work location within the US. Any extended time working outside the United States requires prior written approval. International Contractor: This is a full-time, remote position, but candidates must have four hours overlap with Eastern timezone. Role Overview Knack runs thousands of customer applications across multiple global regions, including dedicated private environments. As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll own and evolve that infrastructure, harden it to meet SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security requirements, and build the infrastructure behind our growing AI capabilities. We’re an AI-forward team. You don’t need to type every Terraform block, but you do need to understand what’s happening, direct AI tools well, verify their work, and own the outcome. This role includes a weekly 24/7 on-call rotation. About Knack Knack is an AI-powered no-code software development platform enabling organizations to manage, analyze, and share business data. The no-code market is growing at over 30% annually and projected to be almost $200B by 2030. Founded in 2010, Knack has grown into a leading player in the no-code movement, enabling businesses, teams, and individuals to build custom applications without writing a single line of code. Serving a wide range of industries, from healthcare and education to finance and nonprofits, and organizations from small businesses to Fortune 500s, Knack enables users to boost data visibility and streamline operations. To date, the platform has powered 400,000 apps and stored more than 5 billion data records for over 15,000 customers. Its enterprise-grade functionality includes an AI-powered visual builder, robust data structures, user access controls, and automation capabilities, all delivered by a fully remote team committed to trust, continuous improvement, and measurable impact. Key Responsibilities Run AWS infrastructure as code, with AI in the loop Manage AWS infrastructure through Terraform using our pull-request-based GitOps workflow, and resolve configuration drift across regions. Use AI tools to draft, review, and explain Terraform changes, then verify every plan before it merges. You own every change you approve, regardless of who or what wrote it. Maintain reusable modules and the standards that make AI-generated changes safe and consistent. Make AWS and Claude work together Help design and operate how AI assistants work with our AWS environments, for investigation, analysis, incident triage, and infrastructure changes. Define the IAM roles, permission boundaries, logging, and approval gates that govern what AI tools can see and do. Evaluate AI access for blast radius and auditability. Implement security controls with our security lead Enforce encryption at rest and TLS in transit, tighten IAM and S3 permissions, manage WAF rules and security headers, and rotate secrets. Drive pentest and audit findings to verified fixes in every environment. Secure the AI tooling itself, including agent credentials, secrets handling, MCP server exposure, and prompt injection risk. Support compliance and audits Configure and maintain SOC 2 and HIPAA controls such as log retention, alarms, VPC flow logs, and backups. Ensure AI-assisted changes keep the same review, approval, and audit trail as any other change. Gather audit evidence and help maintain security tooling. Build monitoring, alerting, and runbooks Create dashboards and monitors that catch issues before customers do, and tune noisy alerts. Keep runbooks current and written so that both people and AI assistants can follow them. Keep systems patched and current Lead OS upgrades, runtime and end-of-life migrations, dependency updates, and certificate renewals. Operate and scale databases and customer environments Tune, resize, and secure databases on multiple platforms. Provision or decommission dedicated customer servers for Sales and Support. Resolve escalations and automate repeat work Troubleshoot production issues for Support, Sales, and Engineering. Replace recurring manual tasks with automation, CI/CD improvements, or self-service tooling, using AI to move faster while verifying what it produces. Participate in on-call Participate in our weekly 24/7 on-call rotation, responding to production alerts and following up with fixes or runbook updates so the same issue does not repeat. Qualifications Experience 3-5 years in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including 2+ years working in AWS production environments. Looking for someone who has experience shipping infrastructure changes through code review. Depth matters more than the number. Experience operating a multi-tenant SaaS platform at scale, including participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation. A degree is not required. Demonstrated hands-on experience counts equally. Technical depth Deep AWS knowledge across compute, networking, and security services, such as EC2, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudFront, and RDS. Strong Terraform understanding, including module design, state management, and pull-request-based CI/CD workflows. You can read a plan and explain what will be created, changed, or destroyed, and where the risk is. Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals: least-privilege IAM, encryption in transit and at rest, network security groups and WAFs, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation. Hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tools and building actionable alerts. Experience administering relational and NoSQL databases in production. Solid Linux and container (Docker) fundamentals. Able to read and reason about code and scripts in Python, Go, Bash, or Node.js/TypeScript, including large JavaScript/TypeScript codebases when tracing infrastructure-related bugs. You do not need to write them from scratch. How you work with AI Daily, practical use of AI tools like Claude, with the judgment to critically review AI-generated scripts, Terraform, and IAM policies, and accountability for everything you ship. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, or ISO 27001, including evidence collection and control implementation. Experience with AWS GovCloud or other regulated or isolated environments. A security certification or equivalent depth, such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CompTIA Security+, or CCSP, or experience with SIEM, intrusion detection, or threat modeling. Experience running AI/LLM infrastructure, such as Amazon Bedrock, LLM gateways, vector databases, or MCP servers. Experience governing AI agent access to cloud environments, including scoped IAM roles, session logging, and approval workflows. Familiarity with GitOps tooling for Terraform and CI/CD platforms such as CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodeBuild. Experience with data warehouses and pipelines (for example, Redshift and ETL tooling). Kubernetes/EKS experience. Experience at a small or early-stage company where you wore many hats. Interviews will be recorded and transcribed by an AI notetaking tool so our team can focus on the conversation and review it accurately later. Notes are used only for evaluating your application. You can opt out at any time by letting your recruiter know. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/knack-cloud-engineer-1

raw.title: Knack: Cloud Engineer
raw.description:
Headquarters: US
URL: https://knack.com

Location: US Based (Full-Time, Remote) or International Contractor (Full-Time, Remote)

If US-Based:
This will be a remote position based in the United States. Knack offers a complete benefits package to those working in the United States. Employees must be available during standard US business hours and maintain their primary work location within the US. Any extended time working outside the United States requires prior written approval.

International Contractor:
This is a full-time, remote position, but candidates must have four hours overlap with Eastern timezone.

Role Overview

Knack runs thousands of customer applications across multiple global regions, including dedicated private environments. As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll own and evolve that infrastructure, harden it to meet SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security requirements, and build the infrastructure behind our growing AI capabilities.

We’re an AI-forward team. You don’t need to type every Terraform block, but you do need to understand what’s happening, direct AI tools well, verify their work, and own the outcome. This role includes a weekly 24/7 on-call rotation.

About Knack

Knack is an AI-powered no-code software development platform enabling organizations to manage, analyze, and share business data. The no-code market is growing at over 30% annually and projected to be almost $200B by 2030. Founded in 2010, Knack has grown into a leading player in the no-code movement, enabling businesses, teams, and individuals to build custom applications without writing a single line of code.

Serving a wide range of industries, from healthcare and education to finance and nonprofits, and organizations from small businesses to Fortune 500s, Knack enables users to boost data visibility and streamline operations.

To date, the platform has powered 400,000 apps and stored more than 5 billion data records for over 15,000 customers. Its enterprise-grade functionality includes an AI-powered visual builder, robust data structures, user access controls, and automation capabilities, all delivered by a fully remote team committed to trust, continuous improvement, and measurable impact.

 

Key Responsibilities

Run AWS infrastructure as code, with AI in the loop

  • Manage AWS infrastructure through Terraform using our pull-request-based GitOps workflow, and resolve configuration drift across regions.
  • Use AI tools to draft, review, and explain Terraform changes, then verify every plan before it merges. You own every change you approve, regardless of who or what wrote it.
  • Maintain reusable modules and the standards that make AI-generated changes safe and consistent.

Make AWS and Claude work together

  • Help design and operate how AI assistants work with our AWS environments, for investigation, analysis, incident triage, and infrastructure changes.
  • Define the IAM roles, permission boundaries, logging, and approval gates that govern what AI tools can see and do.
  • Evaluate AI access for blast radius and auditability.

Implement security controls with our security lead

  • Enforce encryption at rest and TLS in transit, tighten IAM and S3 permissions, manage WAF rules and security headers, and rotate secrets.
  • Drive pentest and audit findings to verified fixes in every environment.
  • Secure the AI tooling itself, including agent credentials, secrets handling, MCP server exposure, and prompt injection risk.

Support compliance and audits

  • Configure and maintain SOC 2 and HIPAA controls such as log retention, alarms, VPC flow logs, and backups.
  • Ensure AI-assisted changes keep the same review, approval, and audit trail as any other change.
  • Gather audit evidence and help maintain security tooling.

Build monitoring, alerting, and runbooks

  • Create dashboards and monitors that catch issues before customers do, and tune noisy alerts.
  • Keep runbooks current and written so that both people and AI assistants can follow them.

Keep systems patched and current

  • Lead OS upgrades, runtime and end-of-life migrations, dependency updates, and certificate renewals.

Operate and scale databases and customer environments

  • Tune, resize, and secure databases on multiple platforms.
  • Provision or decommission dedicated customer servers for Sales and Support.

Resolve escalations and automate repeat work

  • Troubleshoot production issues for Support, Sales, and Engineering.
  • Replace recurring manual tasks with automation, CI/CD improvements, or self-service tooling, using AI to move faster while verifying what it produces.

Participate in on-call

  • Participate in our weekly 24/7 on-call rotation, responding to production alerts and following up with fixes or runbook updates so the same issue does not repeat.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 3-5 years in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including 2+ years working in AWS production environments. Looking for someone who has experience shipping infrastructure changes through code review. Depth matters more than the number.
  • Experience operating a multi-tenant SaaS platform at scale, including participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation.
  • A degree is not required. Demonstrated hands-on experience counts equally.

Technical depth

  • Deep AWS knowledge across compute, networking, and security services, such as EC2, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudFront, and RDS.
  • Strong Terraform understanding, including module design, state management, and pull-request-based CI/CD workflows. You can read a plan and explain what will be created, changed, or destroyed, and where the risk is.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals: least-privilege IAM, encryption in transit and at rest, network security groups and WAFs, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tools and building actionable alerts.
  • Experience administering relational and NoSQL databases in production.
  • Solid Linux and container (Docker) fundamentals.
  • Able to read and reason about code and scripts in Python, Go, Bash, or Node.js/TypeScript, including large JavaScript/TypeScript codebases when tracing infrastructure-related bugs. You do not need to write them from scratch.

How you work with AI

  • Daily, practical use of AI tools like Claude, with the judgment to critically review AI-generated scripts, Terraform, and IAM policies, and accountability for everything you ship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, or ISO 27001, including evidence collection and control implementation.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or other regulated or isolated environments.
  • A security certification or equivalent depth, such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CompTIA Security+, or CCSP, or experience with SIEM, intrusion detection, or threat modeling.
  • Experience running AI/LLM infrastructure, such as Amazon Bedrock, LLM gateways, vector databases, or MCP servers.
  • Experience governing AI agent access to cloud environments, including scoped IAM roles, session logging, and approval workflows.
  • Familiarity with GitOps tooling for Terraform and CI/CD platforms such as CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodeBuild.
  • Experience with data warehouses and pipelines (for example, Redshift and ETL tooling).
  • Kubernetes/EKS experience.
  • Experience at a small or early-stage company where you wore many hats.

 

Interviews will be recorded and transcribed by an AI notetaking tool so our team can focus on the conversation and review it accurately later. Notes are used only for evaluating your application. You can opt out at any time by letting your recruiter know.

 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/knack-cloud-engineer-1

title: Senior Engineer I, Systems Engineering - Controls Engineer
description:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.  

Senior Engineer I - Controls Engineer

ASM | Simulation & Modeling Hub | Almere, Netherlands

Design, tune and validate control systems for ASM semiconductor process tools, with an emphasis on precision temperature control. Work with experienced controls engineers and equipment and process teams to translate process requirements into control strategies, then verify their performance on physical tools. The role combines dynamic modeling, controller development and hands-on testing, with opportunities to take ownership of control functions.

 

Responsibilities

  • Translate process and equipment needs into measurable control requirements for temperature accuracy, stability, uniformity, repeatability and response during recipe changes.
  • Design and tune feedback and feedforward control strategies for heating and cooling systems. Address interactions between zones and account for sensor and actuator limits.
  • Plan and run tests on laboratory and production-representative equipment. Analyze sensor and actuator data, use system identification to develop or calibrate dynamic models, and compare predictions with measured responses.
  • Work with software, equipment and process engineers to integrate control logic, troubleshoot performance on the tool, and support commissioning and validation.
  • Document control logic, test procedures, tuning parameters and validation results so other engineers can reproduce tests and maintain the controls.

 

Required qualifications

  • Degree in controls, electrical, mechanical or mechatronics engineering, applied physics, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Hands-on experience designing, testing or tuning closed-loop controls on physical equipment. Relevant industry, laboratory or applied research projects are welcome.
  • Working proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink or an equivalent environment for dynamic modeling, data analysis and control design. Familiarity with system identification and instrumentation.
  • Ability to troubleshoot equipment methodically and communicate results to colleagues across engineering disciplines.

 

Preferred experience

  • Precision temperature control, heat transfer or thermal instrumentation in semiconductor equipment or other precision industrial systems.
  • Experience with multizone or cascade control, model-based control, sensor calibration or equipment commissioning.
  • Experience with Simcenter Amesim or other tools for modeling system dynamics and validating control strategies

 

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine – Data Infrastructure
description: The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on. What you'll do Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence. Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it. Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims. Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions. Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why. What we're looking for You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi). You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing. Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans. You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale. Bonus Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies Information extraction or truth discovery at scale Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats Example projects Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months. Keep a graph of hundreds of billions of claims current with incremental updates, so a fact that changes on the web reaches it in minutes. Build a system that knows every company and person in the world, with one evidence-backed record each, resolved across the web and every source we ingest. Exa is an equal opportunity employer. title: Senior Integration Software Engineer
description: We are looking for a hands-on Senior Integration Software Engineer to ensure the quality and reliability of software solutions used in real-world sensing and data processing systems. Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence. We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who is passionate about quality, structured validation, and delivering robust software in complex engineering environments. As a Software Test Engineer, you will be responsible for defining and executing practical software tests to validate software components (including algorithms, cloud back-end, and user interfaces) that process sensor signals generated by fiber-optic sensing systems. You will work closely with data scientists, signal processing specialists, back-end developers, and software architects to ensure that products meet functional and non-functional requirements. This role requires a hands-on professional with a proactive mindset, a structured approach to software testing, strong attention to detail, and the ability to understand complex technical systems and translate requirements into effective test strategies. Key Responsibilities Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably. Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components. Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable. Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery. Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests. Testing & debugging: Develop system-level test suites and CI/CD pipelines, diagnose communication failures, and ensure secure, reliable data transfers as the toolbox and backends evolve. Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers. Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits. Review the work of junior engineers and external development partners in depth, promote good practices for packaging, versioning and release, and share integration knowledge across the team. Why Join Us? Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups. Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization. Competitive salary and benefits package. Enjoy regular team activities and company events. Fresh team lunches provided 3 times/week. Qualifications: BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field. Significant professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on system integration, backend or platform development. Extensive experience developing production software in Python, including packaging, testing, dependency management and writing maintainable, well-structured code. Familiarity with systems programming in C++, or Rust, for the purpose of extending Python for more performance or hardware control. Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and messaging interfaces (e.g. MQTT, WebSocket) and data serialization (e.g. protobuf). Experience with realtime data pipelines, and handling high-throughput or streaming data. Experience with Docker, CI/CD and automated testing in a Linux environment. Experience working with software that interacts with physical systems, and comfort doing hands-on integration and troubleshooting in a lab or production environment. Experience reviewing code and designs, mentoring junior engineers, and setting engineering standards. An outcome-focused mindset, with the ability to own a problem end to end or break it down for others. Ability to work with algorithm developers and translate research code into robust, maintainable software. Flexible and proactive in taking on what needs to be addressed, and comfortable in a fast-paced scale-up environment. Good communication skills in English and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external partners. Willingness to work primarily from our Amsterdam headquarters, as parts of the role involve classified information and physical systems. Nice to Have: Knowledge of defense systems or defense standards (e.g. NATO STANAGs, MIL-STD), for example in naval, maritime security or surveillance systems. Experience with the scientific Python stack (e.g. NumPy, SciPy) or integrating signal processing or ML models into production systems. Experience developing software interfaces for controlling instruments or devices. Experience with other messaging or streaming frameworks (e.g. Kafka, ZeroMQ, DDS). Familiarity with observability tooling. Security & Compliance: You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you will apply machine learning to real-world underwater acoustic sensing challenges using Optics11’s fiber-optic technology platforms. This role requires a strong foundation in signal processing, applied mathematics, and statistics, and the ability to combine physics-based acoustic algorithms with data-driven ML methods.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement machine learning solutions for underwater acoustic sensing use cases, including detection, classification, localization and anomaly monitoring within fiber-optic sensing systems.

  • Select and adapt modelling approaches based on data availability, operational constraints and system requirements.

  • Apply strong foundations in applied mathematics, statistics and signal processing (e.g., beamforming, spectral analysis, detection pipelines) and integrate these with modern data-driven ML techniques.

  • Design, train, evaluate and benchmark AI/ML models, ensuring robustness, generalization and deployment readiness.

  • Validate models rigorously across laboratory experiments and offshore field datasets, with clear performance tracking and reproducible experimentation.

  • Analyze and interpret large-scale experimental and real-world fiber-optic sensing datasets, contributing to scalable workflows for data preparation, labelling and augmentation.

  • Support technical trade-offs between accuracy, interpretability, latency and real-time or embedded constraints.

  • Collaborate closely with acoustics engineers, signal processing specialists, software and embedded teams to integrate ML components into operational acoustic sensing pipelines.

  • Translate complex AI/ML results into clear technical insights that inform system-level engineering decisions.

  • Contribute to strong engineering practices, including version-controlled experiments, documentation, traceability, validation standards and continuous improvement of ML components.

  • Stay informed about advances in AI/ML for time-series analysis, sensor fusion and signal-informed learning, and prototype promising approaches that complement the broader technology stack.

What's in it for you? 

  • Competitive salary .

  • Innovative high-tech, international organization .

  • The opportunity to work in a cross-functional and interdisciplinary environment .

  • A lot to learn and to develop, we stimulate personal development .

  • Lunches.


Required Qualifications 

  • MSc in Machine Learning, Signal Processing, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, or a related field. 

  • Strong foundation in linear algebra, probability, statistics, and signal processing. 

  • Proven experience applying AI/ML methods to time-series or sensor data, including techniques such as: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) (e.g., LSTMs), Transformer-based architectures for time-series learning.

  • Hands-on experience with model training, evaluation, and validation in applied settings.

title: Senior Quantum Optics Scientist - Spin-Based Quantum Systems
description: - About Quandela: Quandela is a European deeptech scale-up developing modular, scalable and energy-efficient photonic and spin-optical quantum computers, accessible through the cloud and on-premises. With over 140 employees, we develop our own hardware and software stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to quantum control systems and algorithms. Our ambition is to build large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computers, combining quantum dot technologies, scalable spin-photon interfaces and distributed entanglement within future Spin-Optical Quantum Computing (SPOQC) architectures. - About this position: You will join Quandela's Semiconductor Optics Team, bringing together expertise in quantum optics, spin physics, semiconductor technologies and quantum information. Your focus will be to develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols , improve spin coherence and operation fidelity, and advance optical control techniques for future hybrid quantum computing architectures. We are looking for an experienced experimental scientist who can independently drive complex experimental activities, shape technical directions and translate scientific results into reliable technological building blocks , working closely with our research and engineering teams. With several experimental building blocks still under development, you'll have room to shape technical choices, tackle open scientific challenges and directly influence our technology roadmap. - What you'll do: Spin-based quantum experiments Design, develop and optimize optical experiments involving spin-photon sources. Implement optical control schemes for spin initialization, readout and manipulation. Characterize spin coherence, operation fidelity and entanglement quality. Scientific and experimental ownership Independently drive experimental investigations, from design to validation. Structure and prioritize scientific activities, milestones and technical challenges. Troubleshoot complex experimental systems and propose technical improvements. Share expertise and support less experienced colleagues when relevant. Technology development and integration Develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols. Collaborate with theory, electronics and semiconductor technology teams. Improve experimental robustness, reproducibility and system performance. Translate scientific results into demonstrators and technological building blocks for future multi-spin architectures. - How You Will Grow: During your first 3 months You will become familiar with Quandela's experimental platforms and ongoing demonstrators, contributing your expertise to current technical challenges. Within 6 months You will drive dedicated experimental workstreams, contribute to key technical decisions and strengthen theory-to-experiment feedback loops. Within 1 year You will help shape the team's experimental direction, advance distributed entanglement demonstrations and contribute to future spin-based architectures. Requirements - What we're looking for We are looking for an experienced experimental researcher combining strong scientific expertise, technical autonomy and the ability to drive complex research activities. Must-have PhD in Spin Physics, Quantum Optics or a related field. Hands-on experience with spin-based quantum systems (control, readout or coherence measurements). Proven autonomy in designing, optimizing and troubleshooting complex quantum experiments. Strong understanding of quantum optics, spin coherence and experimental measurement techniques. Ability to lead scientific activities and make independent technical decisions. Comfortable collaborating across experimental, theory and engineering teams Important, but you can grow here Photon-mediated entanglement protocols and multi-spin architectures. Semiconductor quantum emitters, quantum dots and spin-photon interfaces. Advanced optical control, cryogenic platforms and fast electronics. Experimental qualification, system integration and technology transfer. Bonus points Experience bridging academic research and industrial R&D. Experience coordinating scientific projects or mentoring researchers. - Career Stage & Team Contribution: We primarily target candidates with a PhD and 4+ years of postdoctoral or equivalent R&D experience , combining scientific expertise with strong experimental autonomy. Researchers completing a substantial postdoc are also welcome if they demonstrate scientific maturity, technical ownership and readiness for broader responsibilities. People management experience is not required. What matters is your ability to drive scientific activities, tackle complex technical challenges and share your expertise with the team. Benefits Profit-sharing and a company savings plan. Public transport subscription covered at 50%. Annual sustainable mobility bonus for eco-friendly transport (e-bike, electric car). Fully covered health insurance (Alan). Referral program (€1,000 for a junior and €2,000 for an experienced candidate). Access to a nursery via choisir-ma-creche or contribution to childcare expenses. Subsidy for gym membership and sports activities (Gymlib). Meal subsidies (Swile). Localisation of the position : Based at the IPVF campus in Palaiseau, within the Paris-Saclay research ecosystem. Process: Talent Acquisition Interview (30–45 min) Hiring Manager Interview (45–60 min) Technical discussion and presentation of previous research work Meeting with the team and scientific discussion Reference checks Offer - Beyond That At Quandela, you'll work on challenging scientific questions while helping turn experimental advances into technologies for future quantum computers. Our spin-based platforms are still evolving, leaving room to explore new approaches, influence technical directions and take real ownership of experimental challenges. raw.title: Senior Quantum Optics Scientist - Spin-Based Quantum Systems
raw.description:
- About Quandela:

Quandela is a European deeptech scale-up developing modular, scalable and energy-efficient photonic and spin-optical quantum computers, accessible through the cloud and on-premises.

With over 140 employees, we develop our own hardware and software stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to quantum control systems and algorithms.

Our ambition is to build large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computers, combining quantum dot technologies, scalable spin-photon interfaces and distributed entanglement within future Spin-Optical Quantum Computing (SPOQC) architectures.

- About this position:

You will join Quandela's Semiconductor Optics Team, bringing together expertise in quantum optics, spin physics, semiconductor technologies and quantum information.

Your focus will be to develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols, improve spin coherence and operation fidelity, and advance optical control techniques for future hybrid quantum computing architectures.

We are looking for an experienced experimental scientist who can independently drive complex experimental activities, shape technical directions and translate scientific results into reliable technological building blocks, working closely with our research and engineering teams.

With several experimental building blocks still under development, you'll have room to shape technical choices, tackle open scientific challenges and directly influence our technology roadmap.

- What you'll do:

Spin-based quantum experiments

  • Design, develop and optimize optical experiments involving spin-photon sources.
  • Implement optical control schemes for spin initialization, readout and manipulation.
  • Characterize spin coherence, operation fidelity and entanglement quality.

Scientific and experimental ownership

  • Independently drive experimental investigations, from design to validation.
  • Structure and prioritize scientific activities, milestones and technical challenges.
  • Troubleshoot complex experimental systems and propose technical improvements.
  • Share expertise and support less experienced colleagues when relevant.

Technology development and integration

  • Develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols.
  • Collaborate with theory, electronics and semiconductor technology teams.
  • Improve experimental robustness, reproducibility and system performance.
  • Translate scientific results into demonstrators and technological building blocks for future multi-spin architectures.

- How You Will Grow:

During your first 3 months 
You will become familiar with Quandela's experimental platforms and ongoing demonstrators, contributing your expertise to current technical challenges.

Within 6 months 
You will drive dedicated experimental workstreams, contribute to key technical decisions and strengthen theory-to-experiment feedback loops.

Within 1 year 
You will help shape the team's experimental direction, advance distributed entanglement demonstrations and contribute to future spin-based architectures.

Requirements

- What we're looking for

We are looking for an experienced experimental researcher combining strong scientific expertise, technical autonomy and the ability to drive complex research activities.

Must-have

  • PhD in Spin Physics, Quantum Optics or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience with spin-based quantum systems (control, readout or coherence measurements).
  • Proven autonomy in designing, optimizing and troubleshooting complex quantum experiments.
  • Strong understanding of quantum optics, spin coherence and experimental measurement techniques.
  • Ability to lead scientific activities and make independent technical decisions.
  • Comfortable collaborating across experimental, theory and engineering teams

Important, but you can grow here

  • Photon-mediated entanglement protocols and multi-spin architectures.
  • Semiconductor quantum emitters, quantum dots and spin-photon interfaces.
  • Advanced optical control, cryogenic platforms and fast electronics.
  • Experimental qualification, system integration and technology transfer.

Bonus points

  • Experience bridging academic research and industrial R&D.
  • Experience coordinating scientific projects or mentoring researchers.

- Career Stage & Team Contribution: 

We primarily target candidates with a PhD and 4+ years of postdoctoral or equivalent R&D experience, combining scientific expertise with strong experimental autonomy.

Researchers completing a substantial postdoc are also welcome if they demonstrate scientific maturity, technical ownership and readiness for broader responsibilities.

People management experience is not required. What matters is your ability to drive scientific activities, tackle complex technical challenges and share your expertise with the team.

Benefits

  • Profit-sharing and a company savings plan. 
  • Public transport subscription covered at 50%. 
  • Annual sustainable mobility bonus for eco-friendly transport (e-bike, electric car). 
  • Fully covered health insurance (Alan). 
  • Referral program (€1,000 for a junior and €2,000 for an experienced candidate). 
  • Access to a nursery via choisir-ma-creche or contribution to childcare expenses. 
  • Subsidy for gym membership and sports activities (Gymlib). 
  • Meal subsidies (Swile). 

 Localisation of the position : Based at the IPVF campus in Palaiseau, within the Paris-Saclay research ecosystem. 

Process: 

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30–45 min)
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45–60 min)
  • Technical discussion and presentation of previous research work
  • Meeting with the team and scientific discussion
  • Reference checks
  • Offer

- Beyond That

At Quandela, you'll work on challenging scientific questions while helping turn experimental advances into technologies for future quantum computers.

Our spin-based platforms are still evolving, leaving room to explore new approaches, influence technical directions and take real ownership of experimental challenges.

If you're excited by the idea of combining ambitious quantum research with tangible technological impact, we'd love to hear from you, even if your background doesn't match every requirement.

description: Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s. Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française. Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités. Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle d’achat, depuis la consultation fournisseurs jusqu’au suivi des premières livraisons. Une expérience idéale pour développer une vision complète du métier et évoluer dans un environnement technique stimulant. title: Senior Customer Solutions Engineer
description: Life at Plume At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale. We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day. Plume is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Customer Solutions Engineer to join our dynamic team. As a key technical advisor, you'll work directly with Internet Service Providers (ISPs), acting as the bridge between their business needs and our cutting-edge solutions. You'll play a crucial role in the sales process, from initial discovery to successful deployment, ensuring our partners achieve maximum value from our products. title: Junior Quantum Design Engineer
description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! As a Junior Quantum Design Engineer , you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Your core focus will be centred on the layout, simulation, and verification of quantum processor components and superconducting circuits. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual device architectures into production-ready designs while closing the feedback loop between theoretical design intent and empirical performance. Your work will be essential as we scale to increasingly complex systems and deliver on the promise of quantum computing. What you'll be doing Design and lay out superconducting circuit components and test structures, such as resonators, qubits, and control lines. Perform electromagnetic and circuit simulations to predict device parameters and optimise designs. Contribute to design verification, including design-rule checks and review of layouts against fabrication process constraints. Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations. Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust. Your Profile MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a concentration in Quantum Computing or Quantum Technology (PhD is a plus). Understanding of microwave engineering, circuit theory, or superconducting devices, gained through coursework, a thesis project, or an internship. Experience with EM simulation tools (e.g. HFSS, Q3D, Sonnet) and layout tools (e.g. KLayout, Qiskit Metal). Python skills for design automation, simulation workflows, or data analysis. Detail-oriented mindset with a structured approach to design, verification, and documentation. Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and grow within a fast-moving, multidisciplinary team. Familiarity with superconducting qubits, circuit quantisation, or cleanroom fabrication processes is a plus. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. What We Offer: At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect: Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance) Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage. Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture. As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening. WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Are you always one step ahead? The kind of person who has the new hire’s laptop ready before they arrive, notices the meeting-room camera is offline before the call starts, and, after fixing the same problem twice, makes sure nobody has to ask a third time?

We’re looking for an IT Helpdesk Specialist for our Amsterdam office. You’ll own on-site IT here and support colleagues in other hubs remotely, as part of a small global IT team across Amsterdam, Barcelona, São Paulo, Austin, and Yerevan. Our own AI helpdesk agent already answers routine questions in Slack, so your time goes to the work that needs a person: hands-on help, judgment on unclear or risky requests, and care for the people you support.

Our team is organized by domains, and you’ll grow into one of them: Access & Identity (Okta), the area behind most of our requests. Real ownership, from day one. Ready to make it yours?

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the IT team:

We're a small global team in Amsterdam, Barcelona, São Paulo, Austin, and Yerevan, and we keep 400+ manychatters working smoothly and securely. We're organized by domains, so everyone owns an area end to end. AI is part of how we work, including our own helpdesk agent. Our docs live in GitHub, so one good answer helps many people.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

On-site and remote support

  • Be the first person colleagues in Amsterdam reach for IT help: at your desk, in Slack, and through our service desk (Freshservice). Support colleagues in other hubs remotely.

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, and connectivity on a Mac-first fleet managed with Jamf, with some Windows devices. Escalate complex issues to IT Administrators with full context, logs, and what you've already tried.

  • Get every new hire ready on day one (laptop, peripherals, accounts, and a walkthrough of our tools), and close access and collect equipment for leavers, working with the People and Talent teams.

Office, meeting rooms, and events

  • Keep office IT running: Wi-Fi and wired network (UniFi), printers, office access control, Zoom Rooms, displays, and room schedulers. Make sure meeting rooms are ready every day, and work with the building operator, ISPs, and vendors until every issue is resolved.

  • Set up and run AV for All-Hands, internal events, and meetups: microphones, cameras, displays, and streaming when needed. Some events happen outside regular hours.

  • Keep the office hardware inventory accurate in Freshservice Assets, manage the loaner pool and spares, and support local purchases, refreshes, and decommissioning.

Access & Identity (Okta)

  • Run day-to-day Okta administration: users, groups and group rules, app assignments, password resets, MFA, and lifecycle states.

  • Keep our role-based access model clean, and connect new apps to Okta (SAML or OIDC single sign-on, SCIM provisioning) together with system owners and Security.

  • Check every access request for legitimacy and least privilege, and make sure access is right for every joiner, mover, and leaver, including contractors and partners.

  • Act as the European backup for this domain, covering access work during European hours, and grow into co-owning it.

Knowledge and automation

  • Write and maintain knowledge base articles in Markdown. Our docs live in GitHub and go through pull requests, and our helpdesk agent answers from them, so one good article saves many tickets.

  • Spot repeated requests and fix the cause with a better intake form, an article, or a small automation (Freshservice workflows, n8n, scripts). Use AI tools to research, draft, and script, and check the result before it reaches users.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 🎯

  • By day 30: you know the office, the stack, and the people. You close tickets end to end and run onboardings on your own.

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

  • 3+ years of IT support in a SaaS or cloud-first company, where you've covered a broad scope and know the full helpdesk lifecycle.

  • Hands-on Okta administration (or a comparable identity provider such as Entra ID): groups and group rules, app assignments, SAML or OIDC app integration, SCIM provisioning, and user lifecycle.

  • Onboarding and offboarding experience: you know what "day-1 ready" means and deliver it every time.

  • AI as part of how you work. You use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini every day, and describe the task clearly, check the output before you trust it. This one's a must.

title: AI Builder
description: The short version Plenty of companies are still running AI pilots. We moved past that a while ago: AI agents and human experts create, localise, check and refresh content for global B2B brands every day, across markets and languages. The next question is a harder one: not how to make content, but which content a client should make at all. That's where you come in. As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching. We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. If you want to do serious work with AI, this is a good place for it. Everyone here is already building. What Contentoo does Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. We'd rather make them the approver: they brief, review, and approve, and we run everything in between, inside their own workflow and tools. That makes us a product with a large service layer, sitting where SaaS, service and AI overlap. None of that works without good foundations, so that's where we start. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. Every agent, expert and signal draws on that brand context. Skip it, and you get generic content, faster. There's no shortage of software that tells a client what to write. The difference is that we get those foundations right first and then actually do the work. We've been doing that for ten years: 300+ brands, 300,000+ completed projects and 49 languages. What you'll do A suite of Workflows already runs in production, from localisation and creation to brand checks and content refresh. Each one combines AI agents with human experts and works from the client's brand context. In practice, your week splits two ways. Half of it is implementation: getting new clients live, finding out where their situation is different from the last client's, and building the fix quickly, whether that's a new skill for their agent, a connection to their CMS, or a check only their market needs. Then you make that whole process faster and more automated on our side, so the next client goes live with less hand work. The other half is the layer on top, which we're building right now: brand intelligence. Today most marketing teams guess what to write next. We want every client to know. Their own search data shows which pages are slipping, and a page that slips already gets a one-click refresh. Competitor rankings show where others win the topics the client should own. Strategy gets drafted from search data in each market and confirmed by the client, so every piece has a reason to exist. And every week we ask ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google's AI to answer the questions their buyers ask, to see whether the client is named or a competitor is. Every expert fix and every client comment flows back into the brand context, so the platform gets better with each piece. What works for one client becomes a feature for all of them. And our own teams are clients too. Sales asks the CRM and the agents for a prospect's history before a call. Anyone in the company can ask Conny, our assistant on top of KIWI, our company knowledge base, how billing works or what a package includes. Product feedback from clients gets sorted and routed to the right owner by an agent. When one of those tools needs to get better, you build that too, with Claude Code, the Claude and GPT APIs, MCP servers and agent skills: whatever does the job. The team You join the Product team under Olivier (CPO) and report to Joost (AI Lead), in our growing AI team. You'll work closely with Jorge (Product Lead), Cesar (Tech Lead) and our development hub in Valencia. Around you are the Connies: our people in Amsterdam and in our growing Valencia office. Once a month we stop for Success & Drinks, a company update with no slides and lots of energy, where anyone can take the floor to show what they've built. Wins get celebrated in #shoutout, from a sales call that nailed it to the talent team finding the right experts for a client's healthcare content. We play a padel tournament every year, run the city business run together (the ones who don't run come for the drinks afterwards), and take honest feedback seriously enough to train for it. Who you are You're a builder who gets energy from seeing a client actually use what you made. Three things come together in you: Judgement. You quickly see what's really going on with a client, and you're as credible talking ROI with a CFO as architecture with an engineer. You build. You prototype fast and ship, and you're at home with LLM APIs, agents, MCP, skills, and tools like Claude Code. You've built AI tools that real people use, and you can tell us what happened after launch. Hands in the mud. You love being close to clients: fixing what gets in their way, building what solves their next problem, and owning what you ship. Under the hood, it has to work, stay up, and be safe. As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching.

We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. title: GPU Engineer
description: About Kog At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents. Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act. Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs. We've developed several technologies to make this possible: Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs. KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency. Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading. Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach. Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution. Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released. Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today. These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results. We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually. This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it. Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai . What you'll work on You'll join our GPU engineering team to tackle challenging performance problems and help build the internal agents that will accelerate this work. Develop and optimize GPU kernels using C++, CUDA, HIP, and low-level instructions. Investigate GPU architecture, memory access, synchronization, and execution bottlenecks. Profile and benchmark workloads to identify and validate performance improvements. Optimize inference operations and communication across multiple GPUs. Implement and optimize new AI models on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs. Help build AI agents for GPU engineering , enabling automated code optimization, correctness testing, benchmarking, and iterative improvements. Take ownership of technical decisions and their implementation. What we're looking for We're looking for an experienced GPU Engineer who can contribute quickly and independently to complex performance problems. Strong hands-on experience developing and optimizing GPU kernels, ideally using CUDA C++ or HIP/ROCm. Deep understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchy, parallel execution, and performance bottlenecks. Strong C++ skills and experience profiling and benchmarking GPU workloads. Proven ownership of challenging technical projects, from implementation to measured results. Interest in developing AI agents and tools to accelerate GPU engineering. Experience with PTX, CDNA ISA, multi-GPU systems, low-latency inference, or GPU performance portability is particularly valuable. A PhD in HPC, computer science, or a related field is a plus when backed by substantial engineering work. Previous experience building AI agents is not required. Location and availability Candidates must already be based in Paris or elsewhere in Île-de-France. We are not considering relocation from other regions or countries for this position. title: CFD Workflow Automation Intern
description: About Pangea Propulsion: We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems. Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team! We are looking for a CFD Workflow Automation Intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse. About the role: We are seeking a highly skilled intern with a strong programming background and an interest in engineering simulation to help automate repetitive CFD activities across the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team. The role will focus on developing robust, reusable workflows for meshing, simulation setup and launching, data extraction, post-processing, and standardized reporting, with particular emphasis on Cadence and Ansys Fluent environments.   • Réaliser des prises de vue directement chez nos clients : restaurants, hôtels, chefs et maisons premium.
