title: Business Analyst - Enterprise & AI Solutions
description:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

Working in technology & innovation with WPP Enterprise Solutions

At WPP Enterprise Solutions Netherlands, we create connected brands to drive growth. Our expertise spans the full customer journey, with deep capabilities in commerce, consultancy, CRM, CX, data, production, technology, content, media and more. We deliver end-to-end solutions for ambitious B2B and B2C brands, supported by the wider WPP network.

Our work combines strategy, product thinking, experience design, data, engineering and AI to solve real business problems, from enterprise commerce modernisation and digital shelf excellence to AI-enabled content operations, marketing automation, GEO, workflow orchestration and custom AI agents.

About the team

You’ll join the Product Management & AI Solutions team: the group that bridges business strategy, customer experience and technology to deliver scalable commerce and enterprise solutions. We work closely with UX/CX, Data & AI, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Paid and Retail Media, Engineering and Delivery teams.

Our ambition is to move beyond isolated skills and build repeatable, outcome-led propositions around commerce growth topics such as Search & Discovery, Personalisation, CRO & Experience Optimisation, Product Data/PIM & Digital Shelf, Content Supply Chain & AI Content Operations, CRM & Lifecycle Growth, Performance & Retail Media, SEO/GEO and Composable Commerce Modernisation. Alongside this, we are growing our applied AI work: shaping and delivering custom AI agents and AI-enabled workflows for clients, from discovery and pilot through to production and continuous improvement.

Why this role exists

Clients are increasingly asking for integrated solutions rather than isolated delivery capacity. They need people who can understand the business problem, shape the product direction, define the right solution, translate it into clear specifications and guide teams through delivery. At the same time, AI is changing how commerce, content, marketing and operations work, creating a need for analysts who can combine structured requirements thinking with product ownership, enterprise technology understanding and the design of AI-enabled workflows and agents.

This role is designed for someone who can operate as a strong Business Analyst, step into Product Owner responsibilities when needed, advocate for product thinking inside the organisation and help turn our AI and commerce capabilities into scalable client value. You will work across both our commerce and enterprise product work and our applied AI work. The mix depends on client demand, and we expect the AI share to grow over time.

The role

As Business Analyst, Enterprise & AI Solutions, you bridge business needs, product direction and technical delivery across enterprise digital commerce and martech ecosystems. You analyse business processes, clarify user and stakeholder needs, define requirements and support solutioning across the commerce stack: CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation, paid/media platforms and integration layers.

You will also work on AI initiatives such as custom AI agents (for example for pricing, search or customer service), content and marketing automation, product/content enrichment, GEO and organic discoverability, AI orchestration and workflow automation. You do not need to be a machine learning engineer or a domain expert, but you must be technically curious and comfortable working with APIs, data flows, automation tools, LLM-based workflows, AI quality evaluation, governance requirements and human-in-the-loop processes.

Depending on your experience and the project context, you may act as a hands-on BA, a product-minded discovery partner, a proxy Product Owner or a work stream lead. In all cases, your job is to make ambiguity manageable, decisions explicit and delivery focused on measurable value.

What you will do

  • Collaborate with Solution Architects and Product Owners and translate business goals into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, tech architecture, data flows and integration specifications that delivery teams can act on.
  • Work across commerce, martech and enterprise ecosystems, including CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and media platforms.
  • Identify, shape and specify practical AI, automation and workflow orchestration opportunities across content, marketing, commerce and operational processes, from process mapping and readiness checks to a scoped pilot with a clear business case.
  • Specify AI agents and LLM-based workflows: define the task, data sources, tools and integrations, guardrails, human-in-the-loop steps and escalation paths, plus the evaluation criteria that decide when a solution is ready to go live. After launch, help measure quality, adoption and business impact.
  • Act as a Business Analyst or proxy Product Owner when needed by supporting prioritisation, backlog refinement, sprint planning, UAT, release preparation and stakeholder alignment.
  • Connect business, UX, data, SEO/GEO, content, engineering, legal and delivery teams to make sure solutions are valuable, feasible, scalable and well governed.
  • Help make our AI work repeatable and sellable: contribute to proposals, scoping and estimates, and build reusable assets such as discovery templates, requirement patterns, evaluation sets and playbooks.
  • At the senior end of the role, independently lead workstreams, own parts of the client relationship and coach junior analysts or product team members.

Who you are

  • A structured problem-solver who starts with the business problem, not only the requested feature.
  • A product-minded Business Analyst who can move between discovery, specification, prioritisation and delivery support.
  • Comfortable acting as a proxy Product Owner when a project needs stronger product ownership.
  • Technically fluent enough to discuss APIs, data flows, integrations, platform dependencies and implementation trade-offs with engineering teams.
  • Curious and pragmatic about AI: you use AI tools in your own work and understand the opportunity, but also the need for governance, quality, reliability and human oversight.
  • Comfortable with fast-moving technology: you focus on the problem and the outcome rather than a specific tool, and you pick up new platforms quickly.
  • Strong in workshops, stakeholder alignment and decision-making, with the confidence to challenge constructively.
  • Able to represent the Product Management & AI Solutions team inside WPP and help other teams understand the value of product thinking and applied AI.
  • Commercially aware: you can connect requirements and solutions to client value, efficiency, scalability, conversion, discoverability or operational impact.
  • Collaborative and low-ego, with the ability to work across Commerce, UX/CX, Data, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Media, Engineering and Delivery.

What you’ll need

The basics

  • 3-5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, Solution Analyst or similar role, ideally in commerce, martech, enterprise platforms, consulting or a digital agency environment.
  • Experience with digital commerce ecosystems, preferably B2B and/or B2C enterprise environments.
  • Working knowledge of platforms and domains such as CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and paid/media technology.
  • Strong experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, process flows and integration requirements.
  • Good technical understanding of REST APIs, web platforms, data flows, system integrations and common delivery dependencies.
  • Hands-on familiarity with generative AI tools and a working understanding of how LLM-based solutions behave, including their limitations and how to test the quality of their output.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with tools such as Jira, Confluence or similar.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, documentation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent professional English.
  • Currently residing in the Netherlands with a valid work permit.

Bonus points

  • Hands-on experience with automation tools such as n8n, Zapier or similar.
  • Experience shaping AI, LLM, agentic or workflow orchestration use cases in a business or delivery context, ideally including at least one that went live.
  • Familiarity with AI and agent platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, and with concepts such as retrieval (RAG), tool use and evaluation.
  • Familiarity with AI governance and regulation, such as the EU AI Act, and with responsible AI practices.
  • Experience with search and personalisation platforms, composable commerce, PIM/PXM, CDP, CRM or marketing automation platforms.
  • Experience with GA4, BigQuery, SQL, Python, Postman, Figma, Miro or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in Dutch.

In return, this is what we offer

You’ll get access to an international network of clients, colleagues, technology partners and resources. We have a listening ear for ambitious ideas, and together we keep stretching our boundaries. We want you to follow the path you’re building, and we invest in your personal development in a dynamic, collaborative workplace.

Our compensation

  • A monthly salary between €4,800 and €5200 gross, depending on your experience, seniority and fit with the role.
  • A gross annual 8% holiday allowance.
  • Access to our commuting package to suit your individual needs.
  • Competitive pension benefits.
  • A choice of a Mac or Windows laptop.

Our culture

  • A culture of trust, with a feel-at-home vibe and an international environment.
  • Mental health support, including complimentary membership EAP counselling services.
  • Wellness benefits (when available) including yoga classes, an in-house masseuse.
  • The opportunity to work with a renowned international customer base of B2B and B2C brands.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. 

When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions). Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented AI Content Specialist to support the creation, review, quality assurance, and delivery of AI-generated content for our customers. This role will play a critical part in ensuring that AI-generated images and videos meet our standards for product accuracy, visual realism, voice quality, brand presentation, creativity, and overall customer readiness.

The ideal candidate has a strong eye for detail, is comfortable working with AI-powered content generation tools, and can consistently evaluate content against established quality standards. This person will manage images and videos throughout the content production and review workflow, maintain accurate tracking in our project management platform, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality content is delivered efficiently and at scale.

title: Senior Software Engineer — AI-Native Engineering (XTM Foundation)
description: 🌀 The Company Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action. Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action. At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative. As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future. 🎯 The Role We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is genuinely, deeply convinced that AI is transforming the way software gets built, and who wants to make that transformation happen at Filigran. We are looking for an engineer first. This isn't a "we bought Copilot, please roll it out" role, and it isn't only a tooling or development role either: part of the job is building, part of it is trying things on real work, measuring them and telling teams honestly what works and what doesn't. This is a practitioner role for someone who has already lived this shift, who experiments constantly, who knows what works and what doesn't, and who can bring 60 engineers along on that journey. You will join the XTM Foundation team as Filigran's internal reference on AI-Native engineering. You'll propose our approach, build our practices, run experiments, and share the results so that teams can change how they work with confidence. You'll be hands-on, opinionated, and always one step ahead. 💼 Your Responsibilities Define and own Filigran's AI-Native engineering strategy: which tools, which workflows, which practices, and how they evolve as the landscape moves fast. Run structured experiments to evaluate new AI coding tools and agents (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Cline, MCP servers, code generation agents…), measure their real impact on velocity and quality, and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Build the guardrails and engineering standards that ensure AI-generated code is maintainable, tested, and consistent with our quality bar — not just fast to produce. Work directly with product engineering teams (~80 engineers) to embed AI practices into their day-to-day workflows: pair programming with AI, AI-assisted code review, test generation, documentation, and beyond. Share what you learn. Run internal talks, workshops, and demos. Be the person engineers come to when they want to understand what's possible, and what isn't. raw.jobDescription:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is genuinely, deeply convinced that AI is transforming the way software gets built, and who wants to make that transformation happen at Filigran.

We are looking for an engineer first. This isn't a "we bought Copilot, please roll it out" role, and it isn't only a tooling or development role either: part of the job is building, part of it is trying things on real work, measuring them and telling teams honestly what works and what doesn't. This is a practitioner role for someone who has already lived this shift, who experiments constantly, who knows what works and what doesn't, and who can bring 60 engineers along on that journey.

You will join the XTM Foundation team as Filigran's internal reference on AI-Native engineering. You'll propose our approach, build our practices, run experiments, and share the results so that teams can change how they work with confidence. You'll be hands-on, opinionated, and always one step ahead.

💼 Your Responsibilities

  • Define and own Filigran's AI-Native engineering strategy: which tools, which workflows, which practices, and how they evolve as the landscape moves fast.

  • Run structured experiments to evaluate new AI coding tools and agents (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Cline, MCP servers, code generation agents…), measure their real impact on velocity and quality, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

  • Build the guardrails and engineering standards that ensure AI-generated code is maintainable, tested, and consistent with our quality bar — not just fast to produce.

  • Work directly with product engineering teams (~80 engineers) to embed AI practices into their day-to-day workflows: pair programming with AI, AI-assisted code review, test generation, documentation, and beyond.

  • Share what you learn. Run internal talks, workshops, and demos. Be the person engineers come to when they want to understand what's possible, and what isn't. Show real results, including the failures.

  • Stay permanently ahead of the curve — the AI tooling landscape moves weekly. You'll be the one tracking it, filtering the noise, and surfacing what actually matters for a team like ours.

  • Work in the XTM Foundation team to turn AI practices into shared building blocks for every product team: agent workflows in our CI pipelines (dependency updates, flaky test triage, review assistance), shared MCP servers and prompt libraries, versioned AI configuration in the repositories, and written rules on tools and data handling that apply to everyone.

  • Contribute to Filigran's external voice on AI-Native engineering — blog posts, open-source contributions, conference talks — as the opportunity arises.

🤝 Who You'll Work With

  • Reports to: Principal Engineer of XTM Foundation team.

  • Key collaborators: Engineers and Engineering Managers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, and OpenGRC product teams; VP of Technology; CTO.

  • Working model: You will split your time between XTM Foundation team work (research, experimentation, standards) and direct collaboration with product teams to embed AI practices in real engineering workflows.

🧬 Profile We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience — you are a strong engineer first. You understand what good code looks like, and that's what makes your judgment on AI credible.

  • You are genuinely AI-first in how you work. Not as a trend, not as a productivity hack. You've already transformed how you build software, you can show what you built and what you measured, and you want to help others do the same.

  • Proven experience deploying AI-assisted development practices within an engineering team: you've done this before, you know what resistance looks like, and you know what actually works and what doesn't.

  • Deep, hands-on familiarity with the current AI coding tooling landscape: agentic coding tools, LLM-powered code review, prompt engineering for development workflows, MCP ecosystems, and what's coming next.

  • Strong full-stack engineering background — you can evaluate AI output across the whole stack and contribute code yourself when it matters.

  • You can make a clear case, with evidence. You're a natural communicator who can discuss a trade-off with a skeptical senior engineer just as well as you can help a junior developer get started.

  • Comfortable working in a remote-first, async culture with teams across multiple time zones; clear communicator in English.

  • Autonomy and ownership mindset: you drive this agenda without waiting for direction, and you bring others with you rather than working alone.

  • Bonus: experience with open-source communities, cybersecurity domain knowledge, contributions to AI tooling projects, or public writing/speaking on AI-Native engineering.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

🚀 Ready to Join Us?

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Strategic Accounts
description: Company Overview Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models. AI-First by Default At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. If you’re energized by experimenting, adapting, and learning constantly, you’ll thrive here. Expect your day-to-day to evolve as fast as the technology does. Opportunity: Enterprise restaurant deployments are where voice AI meets the messiness of the real world: legacy systems, high transaction volumes, operational edge cases, and technology that has to work reliably during the busiest moments of the day. In this role, you will embed with leading restaurant brands and technology partners to make those deployments successful. You will learn how their systems work, design the integration path, write code, troubleshoot production issues, and adapt Deepgram’s platform to the constraints of live restaurant operations. You will work directly with customer engineering teams and business leaders, owning the technical path from early discovery through go-live and optimization. Your impact will extend beyond any single customer. You will identify patterns across deployments, translate field learnings into product improvements, and build the tools, reference architectures, and playbooks that help the team deploy faster and more reliably across large restaurant fleets. This role is for an engineer who wants direct ownership of customer outcomes and enjoys turning complex, ambiguous deployments into repeatable systems. The goal is simple: make every Deepgram for Restaurants deployment feel effortless to the customer and deliver measurable value from day one. Location: This role is based in New York City or San Francisco, where many of our customers and partners are located. Being close to them helps us move quickly and stay connected to their needs. This role also includes occasional travel to meet with customers, support sales engagements, and participate in key onsite interactions. What You’ll Own: Customer engineering partnership: Embed with customer engineering teams as a trusted technical peer. Lead technical discovery and solutioning for prospects and customers. Technical integration and deployment: Own the end-to-end technical implementation of Deepgram’s voice AI platform for enterprise customers — from scoping and architecture through go-live and optimization. Configuration and customization: Adapt and configure Deepgram’s platform to meet each customer’s unique operational requirements — menu structures, ordering flows, POS integrations, edge cases, and everything in between. Production excellence: Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues in live deployments. Serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues when necessary. Deployment infrastructure leadership: Codify patterns into tools, playbooks, reference architectures, and building blocks the broader team can use for other deployments and customers. Feedback loop to product and engineering: Translate real-world deployment challenges into actionable requirements for Deepgram’s product and engineering teams. You are the voice of the customer inside the building. You’ll Love This Role If You: You are hands-on. You write code, read logs, and ship fixes — you don’t just coordinate. When a customer has a technical problem, you roll up your sleeves and solve it. You operate with extreme ownership and urgency. You treat every customer deployment as if your name is on the product. You partner closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering, but you are just as comfortable on a customer’s Slack channel walking their team through an API integration. It’s Important To Us That You Have: Technical depth: You are an excellent software engineer. You are comfortable working across APIs, SDKs, webhooks, cloud infrastructure, and customer tech stacks. You use AI coding tools to move fast and multiply your output. Customer obsession: Deep, personal commitment to your customers’ technical success. You take their problems home with you. You are not satisfied until the deployment is bulletproof. High slope: Learns fast, adapts quickly, and stays effective in ambiguity without needing constant structure. You figure things out and move forward. You are excited to get your hands dirty solving gritty technical problems over sexy ones. Communication and trust: Able to build deep credibility with both technical and non-technical stakeholders on the customer side. You are calm under pressure and relentlessly reliable. It Would Be Great if You Had: Experience with voice AI, speech-to-text, NLP, or conversational AI systems. Previous early-stage startup or founder-led environment experience — you thrive in environments where you wear many hats and build from zero. Previous experience embedded within a large enterprise customer’s product deployment. Notice : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @ deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

AI-First by Default

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. If you’re energized by experimenting, adapting, and learning constantly, you’ll thrive here. Expect your day-to-day to evolve as fast as the technology does.

Opportunity:

Enterprise restaurant deployments are where voice AI meets the messiness of the real world: legacy systems, high transaction volumes, operational edge cases, and technology that has to work reliably during the busiest moments of the day.

In this role, you will embed with leading restaurant brands and technology partners to make those deployments successful. You will learn how their systems work, design the integration path, write code, troubleshoot production issues, and adapt Deepgram’s platform to the constraints of live restaurant operations. You will work directly with customer engineering teams and business leaders, owning the technical path from early discovery through go-live and optimization.

Your impact will extend beyond any single customer. You will identify patterns across deployments, translate field learnings into product improvements, and build the tools, reference architectures, and playbooks that help the team deploy faster and more reliably across large restaurant fleets.

This role is for an engineer who wants direct ownership of customer outcomes and enjoys turning complex, ambiguous deployments into repeatable systems. The goal is simple: make every Deepgram for Restaurants deployment feel effortless to the customer and deliver measurable value from day one.

Location:

This role is based in New York City or San Francisco, where many of our customers and partners are located. Being close to them helps us move quickly and stay connected to their needs.

This role also includes occasional travel to meet with customers, support sales engagements, and participate in key onsite interactions.

What You’ll Own:

  • Customer engineering partnership: Embed with customer engineering teams as a trusted technical peer. Lead technical discovery and solutioning for prospects and customers.

  • Technical integration and deployment: Own the end-to-end technical implementation of Deepgram’s voice AI platform for enterprise customers — from scoping and architecture through go-live and optimization.

  • Configuration and customization: Adapt and configure Deepgram’s platform to meet each customer’s unique operational requirements — menu structures, ordering flows, POS integrations, edge cases, and everything in between.

  • Production excellence: Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues in live deployments. Serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues when necessary.

  • Deployment infrastructure leadership: Codify patterns into tools, playbooks, reference architectures, and building blocks the broader team can use for other deployments and customers.

  • Feedback loop to product and engineering: Translate real-world deployment challenges into actionable requirements for Deepgram’s product and engineering teams. You are the voice of the customer inside the building.

You’ll Love This Role If You:

  • You are hands-on. You write code, read logs, and ship fixes — you don’t just coordinate. When a customer has a technical problem, you roll up your sleeves and solve it.

  • You operate with extreme ownership and urgency. You treat every customer deployment as if your name is on the product.

  • You partner closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering, but you are just as comfortable on a customer’s Slack channel walking their team through an API integration.

It’s Important To Us That You Have:

  • Technical depth: You are an excellent software engineer. You are comfortable working across APIs, SDKs, webhooks, cloud infrastructure, and customer tech stacks. You use AI coding tools to move fast and multiply your output.

  • Customer obsession: Deep, personal commitment to your customers’ technical success. You take their problems home with you. You are not satisfied until the deployment is bulletproof.

  • High slope: Learns fast, adapts quickly, and stays effective in ambiguity without needing constant structure. You figure things out and move forward. You are excited to get your hands dirty solving gritty technical problems over sexy ones.

  • Communication and trust: Able to build deep credibility with both technical and non-technical stakeholders on the customer side. You are calm under pressure and relentlessly reliable.

It Would Be Great if You Had:

  • Experience with voice AI, speech-to-text, NLP, or conversational AI systems.

  • Previous early-stage startup or founder-led environment experience — you thrive in environments where you wear many hats and build from zero.

  • Previous experience embedded within a large enterprise customer’s product deployment.

  • Own the deepgram.com codebase end to end — the Next.js application (front and back end), the GitHub repo, branching and CI/CD, and code review

  • Optimize and maintain Sanity CMS architecture — schemas, the reusable module library, the staging and production environments and publishing workflow

  • Run the global design system, component library, Vercel platform and spearhead AI integrations. Experienced with global CSS systems.

  • Build and run the site's QA program — starting with a well-structured and scalable staging environment that keeps a marketing site launch-ready at all times

  • Lead internationalization and localization efforts — language-locale URL and routing architecture, hreflang, and the path from i18n plumbing to localized (l10n) content

  • Assist in technical SEO — site architecture, redirects, Core Web Vitals — with on-page SEO executed by content partners inside your review gate

  • Ensure LLM discoverability (AEO) — the site's structured data, metadata, and content architecture must serve answer engines as well as people

  • Marketing Ops partnership — implementation of forms, gated content, and attribution instrumentation (GTM, GA4, HubSpot)

  • Cybersecurity posture — maintain security and run routine safety audits across dependencies and scripts

  • High-velocity shipping — ship complex site improvements and launch campaign pages in a product-driven atmosphere

  • AI-native workflow — use agents in your daily build process and create tooling for safe marketing publishing

We are looking for candidates with:

  • Marketing web development background — ownership of marketing sites, not just product surfaces

  • Enterprise repository ownership: branching strategy, CI/CD, and a strong code-review culture

  • Headless CMS architecture — Next.js with Sanity strongly preferred

  • Modern React ecosystem for the web

  • Vercel as a production platform

  • AI-native development — ability to demonstrate concrete use of AI agents and tooling in your workflow

  • High level of ownership & accountability — a hand raiser who’s ready to join an ambitious team and company

  • Technical leadership — directing or reviewing the work of agency developers

Our ideal candidates also have:

  • Prior experience with internationalization (i18n/l10n): URL architecture, locale routing, and multi-region infrastructure

  • Familiarity with A/B testing on production marketing sites

  • Interest in voice AI and the future of voice-interactive web experiences

raw.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

Who we're looking for

We're seeking an experienced ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer to own the GPU infrastructure that powers our LLM training and serving, and to make every workload on it faster and cheaper. You'll run our H200 cluster end to end, deploy models to production, and profile and optimize our training and inference pipelines down to the kernel level when it matters. You understand GPUs from the cluster scheduler to the memory hierarchy, you measure before you optimize, and you're motivated by turning raw compute into faster iteration for our ML team. You thrive in environments where infrastructure reliability and efficiency directly shape how quickly research reaches millions of users.

What you'll do

GPU Cluster & Infrastructure:

  • Own our H200 GPU cluster end to end: Kubernetes and Slurm for training and inference workloads, with multi-tenant scheduling, quotas, and resource isolation

  • Keep large distributed training runs healthy: node health checks, NCCL and interconnect debugging, automated job recovery, and checkpoint management

  • Track and optimize GPU utilization and cost across training and inference, with dashboards and budget alerting

  • Manage infrastructure-as-code and provisioning for GPU environments

  • Define and monitor SLIs/SLOs for cluster availability and production model serving

Deployment & Serving:

  • Deploy LLMs to production using vLLM or SGLang, with CI/CD, model versioning, and safe rollouts and rollbacks

  • Monitor serving latency, throughput, errors, and cost, and act on regressions

ML Acceleration:

  • Profile training and inference end to end (PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute) to find and remove bottlenecks

  • Improve training throughput and MFU: parallelism strategies (FSDP, tensor and pipeline parallelism), communication/compute overlap, mixed precision and FP8, activation checkpointing, torch.compile

  • Optimize inference: quantization (FP8, INT8, INT4), speculative decoding, prefix caching, continuous batching, KV cache tuning, and parallelism layouts

  • Write or integrate fused and custom kernels (Triton, CUDA) where off-the-shelf implementations fall short

  • Build benchmarking tooling so every optimization ships with measured gains

Enablement & Best Practices:

  • Partner with ML engineers and researchers to make training and serving efficient by default

  • Establish best practices for using the cluster and guide teams in their adoption

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years in ML infrastructure, MLOps, HPC, or platform engineering with focus on GPU workloads

  • Hands-on experience operating multi-node GPU clusters with Kubernetes and/or Slurm, including debugging hardware, networking (NCCL, InfiniBand/RoCE), and job failures

  • Production experience deploying and optimizing LLM inference with vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM

  • Proven track record of profiling and accelerating GPU workloads, with measured results in throughput, latency, MFU, or cost

  • Solid understanding of monitoring and observability for GPU systems (Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM, or similar)

  • Naturally curious with a track record of proactively identifying and implementing improvements

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience writing custom kernels in Triton or CUDA, and familiarity with fused kernels such as FlashAttention

  • Performance tuning of distributed training frameworks: FSDP, Megatron-LM, or DeepSpeed

  • Experience with low-precision training and inference (**FP8**, INT4) and model compression for production deployment

  • Deep knowledge of GPU architectures: memory hierarchy, tensor cores, roofline analysis

  • Experience with multi-tenant GPU scheduling and fair-share resource allocation

  • Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, or Triton

What we offer

  • Critical infrastructure ownership for high-impact AI projects that are strategically vital to the company, with direct visibility to senior leadership including the CEO

  • State-of-the-art GPU infrastructure: H200 fleet, vLLM serving stack, and the freedom to optimize it end to end

  • Expert ML team who have released top Hugging Face models, published at NeurIPS, and built production systems that will run on your infrastructure

  • Significant autonomy in choosing tools and shaping our infrastructure and performance strategy

  • Modern tooling: Latest ML frameworks, coding assistants, best-in-class development environment

  • Hybrid work model with our Amsterdam office - home to the AI House, bringing together 200+ AI professionals through events and collaborations

  • Competitive compensation, top-spec MacBook Pro, and an environment genuinely built for professional growth and learning

If you're excited to own the GPU infrastructure behind cutting-edge LLMs and make every training run and every request faster, let's talk.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Help the Group Communications team use AI and data to work smarter: set up media monitoring, build a shared stakeholder CRM and track the metrics that show our impact. Priority use cases 1. Build a dashboard that pulls data from monitoring, social and CRM sources. Produce monthly and quarterly reporting with clear insights for leadership. Automate data collection and reporting where possible to save the team time. What success looks like First 3 months: media monitoring is live with regular summaries, and the CRM structure is agreed and populated. By the end of the internship: the team uses the CRM day to day, a KPI dashboard is in place, and there is clear handover documentation so the tools keep running. What you bring A current student or recent graduate in communications, data, business, computer science or a related field. A structured way of working, with the ability to turn messy information into clear systems. Clear written English and the confidence to work with senior stakeholders. Nice to have Experience with a CRM (for example HubSpot, Salesforce or Airtable) or a media monitoring tool (for example Meltwater or Cision). We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

Group Communications supports senior leadership and works across a wide network of portfolio companies, partners and AI initiatives. We want to get much better at using AI tools and data to track what is said about us, manage our relationships, and measure the value of our work.

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Ops
description: About Cantina: Cantina Labs is a social AI company, developing a suite of advanced real-time models that push the boundaries of expression, personality, and realism. We bring characters to life, transforming how people tell stories, connect, and create. We build and power ecosystems. Cantina, our flagship social AI platform, is just the beginning. If you're excited about the potential AI has to shape human creativity and social interactions, join us in building the future! About the Role: We are looking for an ML Engineer to own the production inference stack for our text-to-speech (TTS) and speech recognition (ASR) models, end to end. Our research team delivers trained model checkpoints; you will productionize them as low-latency, real-time streaming services that run cost-efficiently on GPUs. The role covers the inference engines, the Kubernetes infrastructure they run on, and the performance benchmarking and accuracy validation that let us ship changes safely. You will bridge research and production, and own latency, throughput, cost and accuracy as we scale. What You’ll Do: Build and optimize streaming inference engines for TTS and ASR models, including multi-stage model pipelines. Optimize latency (time to first chunk, p50/p99) and throughput using continuous batching, CUDA Graphs, torch.compile and mixed precision. Maintain numerical parity with the reference implementation through automated accuracy regression tests, per stage and end to end. Deploy and operate GPU inference services on Kubernetes: autoscaling, containerization and infrastructure as code. Build CI/CD for model artifacts, with model versioning and reproducible releases. Own observability and performance benchmarking: p50/p99 latency, real-time factor (RTF), GPU utilization and cost per request. Partner with research to productionize new models. What You’ll Bring: Hands-on experience deploying, scaling and optimizing ML models in production, beyond consuming model APIs. Working knowledge of the full inference stack, from CUDA kernels to serving frameworks, with depth in some layers; expertise across all of them is not expected. GPU performance optimization: profiling (Nsight Systems, PyTorch Profiler), memory bandwidth, CPU-GPU synchronization. Solid understanding of model serving: continuous batching, KV cache management, request scheduling. Production experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure. Strong Python and PyTorch, and a rigorous approach to performance benchmarking. Experience with speech or audio models (TTS, ASR, voice conversion). Experience with inference frameworks such as vLLM (vLLM-Omni), SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT or Triton Inference Server. Compensation: When determining compensation, a number of factors will be considered, including skills, experience, job scope, location, and competitive compensation market data. raw.jobDescription:
Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission

As a Senior CXE Engineer, you are a hands-on builder on enterprise contact center transformations. You will spend the majority of your time in code and in the AWS console: building contact flows and AI agents, writing Lambda functions and CDK stacks, developing React-based agent and admin tooling, and debugging production issues on systems that serve tens of thousands of agents and millions of customer interactions. You work within architectures set by practice leads, and you’re expected to pressure-test them, propose better patterns, and own the implementation quality of your workstream from first commit through production cutover. This role blends deep Amazon Connect platform engineering, generative AI development on Bedrock and Claude, and full-stack serverless work, with regular direct interaction with customer engineering teams.

Your Assignment

AI Agent & Conversational AI Development

  • Build AI-native self-service using Amazon Connect AI agents, Amazon Q in Connect, and Amazon Bedrock (Claude model family), implementing multi-agent orchestration patterns, orchestrator agents delegating to task-specific agents with escalation paths to human queues
  • Engineer prompts and tool-calling integrations at production scale: SearchProfiles lookups, case creation, external API tools, authentication flows, and guardrails against hallucination and verification loops
  • Implement barge-in handling, fallback, and error-recovery behavior for voice AI, and validate it with turn-by-turn trace analysis
  • Optimize inference cost and latency hands-on: model tier selection (Haiku vs. Sonnet vs. Opus), prompt caching, and token budgeting against containment- rate targets
  • Diagnose AI agent performance using observability tooling (agent spans, and CloudWatch) that correlates contact flow logs, conversation transcripts, AI agent spans, tool executions, and token usage to isolate latency, cost, and quality issues
  • Build conversational experiences where intent-based NLU is the right fit, including multilingual support and SSML-tuned voice interactions

Amazon Connect Platform Engineering

  • Build contact flows that integrate AI agents, Lambda-backed business logic, Customer Profiles, and dynamic data-driven routing
  • Implement Amazon Connect Cases and Tasks solutions: case templates, queue-based work allocation, SLA/TAT monitoring, approval workflows, and migrations from legacy case systems (e.g., consolidating hundreds of service categories and thousands of business rules into a unified Cases model)
  • Configure and operationalize Contact Lens for real-time sentiment, post-contact summaries, category rules, and quality management
  • Implement proficiency-based and attribute-driven routing, outbound campaigns (including answering machine detection and compliance controls), and workforce management (WFM) integrations for forecasting, scheduling, and adherence (FCS)
  • Build out the Amazon Connect analytics data lake (Glue, Lake Formation, Athena) and QuickSight dashboards for real-time operations and executive reporting
  • Support legacy platform migrations (Avaya, Genesys, Cisco, Oracle, Salesforce): flow conversion, data migration, parallel-run validation, and production cutover on live contact centers

Full-Stack & Portal Engineering

  • Build custom Agent Workspace experiences with the Amazon Connect Streams API, third-party app embedding, and CRM screen-pop integrations (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle, custom systems)
  • Build serverless, event-driven backends with Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, and Kinesis for real-time event processing and customer journey orchestration
  • Treat accessibility as a first-class requirement: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant components, automated axe-core/Playwright accessibility scanning, and support for VPAT/Section 508 documentation on government and enterprise engagements

Infrastructure, Delivery & Quality

  • Author infrastructure as code with AWS CDK (TypeScript) as the primary tool and CloudFormation or Terraform where customer environments require them
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and automated test suites: Jest/Vitest unit tests, Playwright E2E and API tests, and integration tests against live Connect instances
  • Follow phased rollout patterns for production contact centers where downtime is measured in missed calls; write the runbooks that make cutovers boring
  • Instrument monitoring and alerting (CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and custom dashboards across voice, chat, tasks, queues, agents, Lambda, and AI agents) and participate in production incident triage
  • Apply security and compliance baselines in everything you ship: least-privilege IAM, DevSecOps scanning, encryption standards

Collaboration & Practice Contribution

  • Work directly with customer engineering teams: pair on integrations, run technical working sessions, demo completed workstreams, and lead knowledge transfer so customers can operate what you build
  • Contribute to architecture decisions within your workstream; evaluate native Connect capability before custom builds (“configuration over customization”), surface trade-offs to practice leads, and document decisions
  • Perform code reviews, uphold engineering standards, and mentor junior and mid-level CX engineers through pairing and review feedback
  • Contribute reusable assets back to the practice, shared CDK constructs, skills/plugins, demo environments, and internal tooling, so the next engagement starts further ahead
  • Support pre-sales when needed: build proof-of-concept demos and provide implementation-grounded input on estimates and SOW technical scope

Your Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including 2+ years building on Amazon Connect or comparable CCaaS platforms at enterprise scale
  • Strong, current Amazon Connect skills: contact flows, routing, Cases and Tasks, Contact Lens, Customer Profiles, Streams API, and the Connect data/analytics stack
  • Hands-on experience with conversational and generative AI, Amazon Lex plus LLM- based development (Amazon Bedrock, Q in Connect, or equivalent), including prompt engineering and tool calling
  • Strong TypeScript/Node.js and Python; production React experience; solid AWS serverless engineering (Lambda, EventBridge, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Step Functions, Kinesis)
  • Infrastructure as code proficiency with AWS CDK or Terraform, including multi- account deployment patterns
  • Experience shipping and supporting production systems, testing discipline, observability instrumentation, and incident debugging across the full stack
  • Clear communication with customer-facing composure, able to demo your work, explain trade-offs, and run working sessions with client engineers

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, Developer, or ML/Connect-relevant Specialty)
  • Contact center migration experience (Avaya, Genesys, Cisco, Oracle, or Salesforce to Amazon Connect)
  • Experience in regulated verticals: government/public sector (Section 508, FedRAMP), healthcare (HIPAA), or financial services
  • Contact center operations fluency: WFM concepts (forecasting, scheduling, adherence), quality management, outbound compliance (TCPA), and CX KPIs (containment, AHT, CSAT, SLA/TAT)
  • Experience with AI observability (trace correlation, token/cost attribution, latency profiling) or accessibility engineering (WCAG 2.1 AA, axe-core automation)
  • Consulting or client-delivery background

Benefits

  • 100% remote work
  • Medical Insurance for you and eligible dependents
  • Generous holidays and flexible PTO
  • Competitive phantom equity
  • Paid for exams and certifications
  • Peer bonus awards
  • State of the art laptop and tools
  • Equipment & Office Stipend
  • Individual professional development plan
  • Annual stipend for Learning and Development
  • Work with an amazing worldwide team and in an incredible corporate culture

NOTE: This position requires current legal authorization to work in the country where this position is located. Caylent is not able to sponsor visa or work permit applications at this time.

As part of our recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools or automated systems to assist with the screening and evaluation of applications to help match candidate qualifications with job requirements.
These tools are designed to support — not replace — human decision-making. Final hiring decisions are always made by our trained recruitment professionals.
If an AI or automated tool is used during your application process, it will only be in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, and your information will be handled in a secure and confidential manner.
If you have any questions, please contact talent@caylent.com

Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at Caylent.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you would like to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at hr@caylent.com.

description: About XBOW Build the future of offensive security with XBOW. Attackers are already using AI to move faster than defenders can react—we’re creating the platform that puts security ahead in the arms race. Our AI-powered system autonomously discovers, validates, and even exploits vulnerabilities, giving organizations proof-backed results in hours instead of weeks. Founded by Oege de Moor, creator of GitHub Copilot, and backed by Sequoia, Altimeter, and other leading investors, XBOW is applying cutting-edge AI to one of the world’s most urgent problems. In just over a year, our AI, built by a world-class AI team and legendary security researchers — has uncovered thousands of real-world zero-days across the software billions rely on, and achieved the #1 ranking on HackerOne’s global leaderboard. We’re a team of builders, hackers, and researchers who thrive on solving problems others think are impossible. If you want to push the boundaries of AI, reshape how security is done, and join the group defining this new era of defense — we’d love to talk. In this role, you’ll design and implement end-to-end features across the stack: from React-based frontends and TypeScript APIs to backend services in Kotlin and Go, all deployed on AWS. You’ll be joining a small team of superstars that’s shipping quickly and operating with high trust. This is a role for someone who loves to own open-ended problems and figure things out—whether that’s designing seamless API contracts, optimizing database interactions, or building scalable systems that make powerful AI capabilities accessible. If you like being at the intersection of deep tech and real-world impact, you’ll feel right at home. Background in systems programming, networking, or performance tuning Experience with hybrid deployments (cloud + on-prem) and know how to build resilient systems that handle the complexity of mixed environments. Experience working in an early stage startup Prior experience building security products or products for technical users What We Offer Compensation & Equity: Competitive salary and a generous equity package, making you a true owner of the company. Career Growth: Shape your role, lead the function, and grow with the company as we redefine cybersecurity. Meaningful Work: You will tackle technically complex challenges and play a pivotal role in the growth of our business, working alongside an amazing team and some of the world’s experts to shape how AI transforms cybersecurity. Hiring Process: 45-min introductory chat with our Talent team. 45 minutes with one of our Engineering Leads. 2-3 hour technical deep dive around relevant case study. 30-min final meeting with the Engineering Lead for the assigned team.. About XBOW

Build the future of offensive security with XBOW. Attackers are already using AI to move faster than defenders can react—we’re creating the platform that puts security ahead in the arms race. Our AI-powered system autonomously discovers, validates, and even exploits vulnerabilities, giving organizations proof-backed results in hours instead of weeks.

Founded by Oege de Moor, creator of GitHub Copilot, and backed by Sequoia, Altimeter, and other leading investors, XBOW is applying cutting-edge AI to one of the world’s most urgent problems. In just over a year, our AI, built by a world-class AI team and legendary security researchers — has uncovered thousands of real-world zero-days across the software billions rely on, and achieved the #1 ranking on HackerOne’s global leaderboard.

We’re a team of builders, hackers, and researchers who thrive on solving problems others think are impossible. If you want to push the boundaries of AI, reshape how security is done, and join the group defining this new era of defense — we’d love to talk.

Your Role

We’re looking for a Software Engineer who’s passionate about building reliable and high quality products with robust backend systems. In this role, you’ll design and implement end-to-end features across the stack: from React-based frontends and TypeScript APIs to backend services in Kotlin and Go, all deployed on AWS.

You’ll be joining a small team of superstars that’s shipping quickly and operating with high trust. This is a role for someone who loves to own open-ended problems and figure things out—whether that’s designing seamless API contracts, optimizing database interactions, or building scalable systems that make powerful AI capabilities accessible. If you like being at the intersection of deep tech and real-world impact, you’ll feel right at home.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build full-stack systems that integrate frontend and backend seamlessly

  • Develop scalable APIs and backend services in TypeScript, Kotlin, and Go

  • Deploy and operate services in AWS and other cloud providers

  • Own problems end-to-end—from design through deployment to production support

  • Navigate ambiguity and help define how we build as much as what we build

  • Collaborate closely with teammates across the stack, including AI researchers, Security researchers and backend engineers

Who You Are

  • Experience building and operating full-stack systems

  • Proficiency with TypeScript

  • Experience designing and consuming APIs (REST or GraphQL)

  • Strong backend development experience (Node.js, Kotlin, Go, or similar languages)

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with incomplete information

  • A thoughtful communicator who values clarity and simplicity

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, early-stage startup environment

Bonus If You Have

  • Experience with event-driven architectures, message queues, or async workflows

  • Experience building scrappy, iterative frontends where speed and feedback loops matter more than polish

  • Familiarity with AWS or similar cloud platforms

  • Comfort working with infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform or CDK)

  • A strong appreciation for user experience and design, even if you’re not a formal designer — you care about how features feel as much as how they work

  • Comfortable prototyping quickly in React/TypeScript and turning ideas into working features fast

  • Experience designing and optimizing relational databases (we use Postgres), and you know how to structure data for both performance and clarity.

  • Background in systems programming, networking, or performance tuning

  • Experience with hybrid deployments (cloud + on-prem) and know how to build resilient systems that handle the complexity of mixed environments.

  • Experience working in an early stage startup

  • Prior experience building security products or products for technical users

What We Offer

  • Compensation & Equity: Competitive salary and a generous equity package, making you a true owner of the company.

  • Career Growth: Shape your role, lead the function, and grow with the company as we redefine cybersecurity.

  • Meaningful Work: You will tackle technically complex challenges and play a pivotal role in the growth of our business, working alongside an amazing team and some of the world’s experts to shape how AI transforms cybersecurity.

What Else You Should Know

  • Location: Remote (all team members are remote but we meet regularly and you’re supported to travel to collaborate with colleagues in person)

  • Contract: Full-time.

  • Hiring Process:

    1. 45-min introductory chat with our Talent team.

    2. 45 minutes with one of our Engineering Leads.

    3. 2-3 hour technical deep dive around relevant case study.

    4. 30-min final meeting with the Engineering Lead for the assigned team..

We aren't focused on seniority titles at XBOW—so if you’re worried about “leveling,” don’t be. We care a lot more about mission fit, capability, and impact than what’s on your LinkedIn headline.

We believe in people who are driven by curiosity and a willingness to learn. Even if you don't check every box, we encourage you to apply if you're excited about the role and our mission.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: What Makes Cloudbeds Unique At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started. How You'll Make an Impact: As a Senior Software Engineer on the Core AI Squad, you'll design, build, and operate customer-facing AI platform capabilities that power intelligent product experiences across Cloudbeds. This is a product engineering role focused on production AI systems, agentic workflows, evaluation, and observability - not an internal tooling role. You'll work primarily in Python while collaborating across our broader PHP and Java ecosystem, building systems where correctness, reliability, latency, cost, and model quality are core to the job. Your goal is to help Cloudbeds ship AI-powered customer experiences that are useful, trusted, scalable, and measurable. Our Core AI Squad: The Core AI Squad owns the customer-facing AI platform infrastructure, agentic workflows, and evaluation and observability foundations that enable AI-powered experiences across Cloudbeds products. The team builds the production capabilities that let us evaluate models and providers for specific use cases, orchestrate tools and workflows, measure quality over time, and integrate AI safely into real customer journeys. You'll join a senior, product-minded group that values ownership, pragmatic architecture, fast learning, and strong collaboration across product, design, data, and engineering. What You Bring to the Team: Design, build, and operate customer-facing AI platform services and product features primarily in Python, while integrating with PHP and Java systems as needed Build and evolve agentic harnesses, including agent runtimes, workflow orchestration, tool execution, state management, recovery paths, and evaluation hooks Integrate agents and LLM-powered workflows into production systems with strong attention to reliability, correctness, latency, scalability, and cost Evaluate models and providers for specific product use cases, using clear success criteria and abstractions that keep the platform flexible as the AI ecosystem evolves Own evaluation, tracing, observability, and quality feedback loops for AI features so the team can detect regressions, understand behavior, and improve over time Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code and advocate for engineering best practices, test automation, maintainability, and operational excellence Collaborate with product, design, data, security, and engineering partners to turn ambiguous AI product opportunities into reliable customer-facing features Comfort building, debugging, and operating services that interact with PostgreSQL, SQS, gRPC, and REST APIs, including data models, event streams, service contracts, and versioning Contribute as a senior individual contributor through technical leadership, architecture input, pair programming, code reviews, and mentorship What Sets You Up for Success: 5+ years of software engineering experience building, shipping, and operating production systems Strong proficiency with Python in production environments, including APIs, services, tests, debugging, and operational ownership Hands-on experience building, integrating, or evaluating agentic systems, agent harnesses, tool orchestration, or LLM-powered workflows Experience with agentic frameworks and tooling such as LangChain, LangSmith, LangGraph, or similar platforms (PydanticAI, CrewAI, etc) Experience with MCP, vector databases, retrieval patterns, RAG architectures, or AI evaluation platforms Comfortable working across a polyglot stack, especially contributing to or integrating with PHP and Java services when the product requires it Familiarity with prompt and version management, guardrails, tracing, LLM observability, cost and latency optimization, or human-in-the-loop workflows Experience with cloud infrastructure and containerization such as Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS, plus experience working with remote-first, globally distributed teams Experience with API-driven design, distributed systems, data modeling, and reliable service boundaries Strong knowledge of software best practices, design patterns, performance, security-minded development, and testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills, especially in complex systems with uncertain or probabilistic behavior Good product sense, customer empathy, strong communication, teamwork, ownership, and time management Business-level English fluency, verbal and written Compensation: Depending on your skills and experience, you can expect your annual compensation to be between $140,000 and $180,000 USD. Please note that we maintain high flexibility, and packages above this range will be considered. ( The salary is only for US-based candidates). Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas. What to Expect - Your Journey with Us Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel.
